title: Project & Operations Manager (Creative Media)
description:
VISION & OPPORTUNITY



Kipkeh Media is a high-volume US media network expanding its core production engine across vlogs, local business spots, and community features. We are seeking a structured, high-agency Project & Operations Manager (Creative Media) to serve as the central operational engine connecting our field creators, intake team, and video editors.

We need a dedicated Project Manager who understands creative video workflows—someone who brings order, speed, clear systems, and sharp content intuition to keep high-volume media projects moving smoothly from raw capture to final publish.



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES



End-to-End Project Management: Oversee the full lifecycle of Kipkeh Media video content. Track production pipelines, manage shifting priorities, and enforce delivery deadlines across multiple concurrent projects.

Pre-Edit Asset QA & Creative Briefs: Audit incoming raw video footage before handing off to video editors. Evaluate visual/audio quality, identify high-value promotional hooks, and write clear creative notes on what to cut, keep, or emphasize.



Cross-Functional Team Alignment: Lead daily syncs across field creators (hosts/vloggers), remote intake specialists, and post-production editors to keep all moving parts synchronized and accountable to publishing dates.

SOP & Dashboard Optimization: Maintain clean, real-time tracking systems (Google Workspace, Slack, PM tools) and continuously optimize workflows as our media portfolio grows.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Project Management Expertise (Primary): 2+ years of proven experience as a Project Manager, Operations Coordinator, or Production Lead in a digital media, agency, or video environment.

Creative & Video Intuition: A sharp eye for raw footage evaluation, video story structure, and recognizing engaging commercial hooks for local business promotions.

Agile Problem-Solving: High agency and composure under pressure—you adapt quickly to changing daily production schedules without losing track of details.

Technical Proficiency: Expert-level command of Google Workspace (Sheets, Docs), Slack, and modern project management platforms (e.g., Asana, ClickUp, Trello).

Clear Executive Communication: Advanced written and spoken English skills to articulate creative briefs, coordinate remote teams, and report to US leadership.



COMPENSATION & PERKS



Hourly Rate: $5.00 – $6.50 USD / hour (scaled strictly to project management capability and media experience).

Schedule & Stability: 40 hours per week built around core US sync windows and editorial deadlines.

Reliable Payments: Fast, predictable weekly processing via Wise.

Career Growth: Direct ground-floor opportunity to advance into senior operational leadership as our media network expands.



HOW TO APPLY



To ensure a smooth and efficient screening process, please complete the following steps:

Application Package: Include a single Google Drive or iCloud link (set permissions to "Anyone with the link can view") containing:

Updated Resume / CV (highlighting media or creative project management experience).

Tech Specs & Speed Test Screenshots: Proof of 16GB+ RAM (if lower, state in your text if your system is upgradable) and primary/backup internet speeds.

title: Audio Editor – Voiceover Cleanup & Editing | Beginners Welcome
description:
We are looking for a reliable Audio Editor to help clean and edit voiceover recordings on an ongoing basis.



BEGINNERS ARE WELCOME! You do not need years of professional experience. If you know how to edit audio, have good attention to detail, and are willing to learn our editing style, we encourage you to apply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:

You will receive raw voiceover recordings and turn them into clean, ready-to-use audio.



Your responsibilities will include:

* Removing mistakes and retakes

* Removing repeated sentences or words

* Removing/reducing breaths between sentences

* Cutting long pauses and unnecessary silence

* Removing mouth noises, clicks, and distracting sounds

* Cleaning up background noise when needed

* Making cuts sound natural and seamless

* Keeping the speaker's natural voice and personality

* Making sure the volume is consistent

* Exporting the finished audio in the required format



This position focuses on spoken-word and voiceover recordings. This is NOT music production.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should be:

* Reliable and dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Able to follow instructions carefully

* Comfortable receiving feedback

* Available consistently

* Able to complete projects quickly

* A clear communicator

* Interested in ongoing work



You do NOT need to be an advanced audio engineer. We care more about your ability to follow instructions, learn quickly, and consistently deliver clean audio on time.



WORKLOAD

This is ongoing work with recordings available regularly.

We are looking for someone who can eventually handle multiple voiceover recordings per day when needed.



TEST EDIT

Applicants who appear to be a good fit will be sent a short audio file to edit as a test. The test will allow us to see how well you follow instructions and whether your editing style matches what we're looking for.



HOW TO APPLY

Reply to this job posting and include:

1. Your name

2. Your audio-editing experience — beginners are welcome

3. What editing software you use

4. How many hours you are generally available each day

5. Your typical availability Monday–Sunday

6. Agree to rate: PAY: $1.25–$2.25 USD per audio project, based on the length of the raw recording. Most recordings are approximately 10–35 minutes. This is ongoing work, and multiple projects may be available per day.

7. What day and time are you available to complete quick test project?

8. Please put “AUDIO EDITOR” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job post.

title: Copywriter/Scriptwriter for real estate and youtube
description:
Strong Real Estate Focus



We’re looking for a creative, strategic Copywriter and Content Strategist to support an Austin-based real estate professional and content creator.



This role goes beyond checking grammar or writing basic captions. We need someone who can organize ideas, develop content strategies, and turn real experiences into natural, engaging scripts across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Shorts, and written platforms.



Real estate will be the primary focus, alongside supporting content about fitness, family, lifestyle, and entrepreneurship.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:



- Content Strategy and Planning

- Build and manage a rolling 30-day content calendar

- Organize content across real estate, business, fitness, family, and lifestyle

- Generate 10–15 relevant content ideas each week

- Develop content from property listings, market updates, client experiences, daily activities, audience questions, and industry trends

- Plan the right mix of short-form videos, long-form content, and written posts

- Organize drafts, revisions, approvals, and publishing status using Notion, Trello, Asana, or a similar tool



Real Estate Content

- Write compelling property descriptions for social media

- Turn listing details into story-driven content that highlights the property’s value, lifestyle, location, and ideal buyer

- Write scripts for listing tours, property showcases, market updates, behind-the-scenes content, and real estate education

- Create content that builds authority, audience trust, and potential buyer or seller interest

- Research properties, neighborhoods, market trends, and relevant real estate topics

- Ensure all property information is accurate and compliant with fair-housing standards



Short-Form Scriptwriting

- Write engaging 30-to-60-second scripts for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts

- Provide three hook options for each concept, including spoken hooks, on-screen text, and visual ideas

- Provide on-screen text, key phrase emphasis, captions, SEO keywords, and relevant hashtags

- Write clear visual or B-roll suggestions that the editor can follow

- Create scripts that sound natural when spoken—not formal, robotic, or overly polished



Long-Form YouTube Content

- Develop detailed outlines and scripts for YouTube vlogs, property tours, and real estate-focused videos

- Create A-roll talking points and corresponding B-roll suggestions

- Build a clear story arc for each video instead of relying on random clips

- Develop title options and thumbnail concepts before filming

- Structure videos to improve viewer retention and keep the story moving

- Turn raw ideas, voice notes, property details, or real-life situations into film-ready outlines



Repurposing Content

- Turn one YouTube video, vlog, or transcript into multiple pieces of content

- Repurpose long-form content into 3–5 short-form scripts

- Create supporting captions, text posts, newsletters, or LinkedIn content

- Identify strong moments from existing footage that can become standalone content



- Brand Voice and Written Copy

- Learn and maintain the creator’s personal voice across every platform

- Write social media captions designed to encourage comments, shares, and saves

- Draft newsletters featuring market insights, personal updates, and behind-the-scenes stories

- Help write messaging for partnerships, sponsorships, brand outreach, and media opportunities

- Keep the tone conversational, confident, direct, relatable, and human



What We’re Looking For

- Proven experience in copywriting, content strategy, or scriptwriting

- Strong understanding of real estate content and property marketing

- Experience writing for YouTube, Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts

- Ability to write strong verbal, visual, and on-screen hooks

- Strong storytelling, research, grammar, and fact-checking skills

- Understanding of audience retention and social media content structure

- Ability to write for speaking rather than simply writing for reading

- Comfortable receiving feedback and revising work

- Organized, dependable, and able to meet deadlines

- Experience using Notion, Trello, Asana, or similar project-management tools

- Ability to work closely with a content creator, social media manager, and video editors



 Preferred but Not Required

- Experience working with a real estate agent, brokerage, or property-focused creator

- Knowledge of the Austin or Texas real estate market

- Familiarity with YouTube SEO and content performance

- Experience building content systems for a personal brand

- Basic understanding of video production, A-roll, B-roll, and editing workflows



How to Apply



Please submit:

- A short introduction about yourself and your experience

- Your portfolio or relevant writing samples

- One real estate property description you’ve written

- One short-form video script with a strong hook

- One long-form YouTube outline or script

title: Executive & Operations Assistant – US Real Estate
description:
FULL-TIME NIGHT SHIFT | LONG-TERM | PHILIPPINES-BASED



Lien Resolution Corp. is a Florida-based company working in residential property, finance litigation, and business operations. We are looking for a highly reliable Executive & Operations Assistant to become the owner’s right hand and keep important work moving without constant supervision.



This is a NIGHT SHIFT role following Florida business hours:

Monday–Friday, 9:00 PM–6:00 AM Manila time.

The shift changes by one hour when the US changes clocks.



If you are looking for daytime work, this position is not suitable. You must have stable internet plus a genuine backup connection and be comfortable making calls throughout your shift.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Call US county offices, code-enforcement departments, court clerks, judicial assistants, title companies, insurers, contractors, and other contacts.

• Follow up on property liens, violations, permits, hearing dates, filing status, missing documents, invoices, and open tasks.

• Manage
: sort, flag urgent matters, draft routine replies, and make sure nothing is missed.

• Research public records through county clerk, property appraiser, tax collector, court-docket, and municipal websites.

• Coordinate contractors: schedules, progress, photos, quotes, invoices, permits, and documents.

• Organise files in Google Drive using exact folder and naming conventions.

• Maintain clear task, call, property, and follow-up status lists.

• Manage calendars across time zones and coordinate flights, hotels, transport, and itineraries.

• Take ownership of unfamiliar tasks: research the problem, propose a solution, and follow through until it is complete.



IMPORTANT: This is not a paralegal role. You will not provide legal advice, make substantive statements about cases, sign filings, or file documents. Your work is administration, coordination, research, information-gathering, and follow-up.



REQUIREMENTS



• Excellent spoken and written English.

• Confident, clear, professional phone manner with Americans.

• Comfortable asking follow-up questions and politely pushing for a clear answer.

• Strong initiative: you investigate problems instead of waiting for step-by-step instructions.

• Highly organised and detail-oriented.

• Reliable night-shift experience or a proven ability to work nights.

• At least 25 Mbps stable internet, plus a real backup connection.

• Computer, proper headset, and quiet workspace.

• Comfortable using AI for research and first drafts, but able to write natural, human
s.

• Honest and direct communication when a problem arises.



NICE TO HAVE



• US real-estate, title, foreclosure, property-management, municipal lien, BPO, or US-facing call-centre experience.

• Google Workspace, CRM, project-management, or public-record database experience.



PAY AND BENEFITS



• $900–$1,200 USD/month depending on experience

• Paid twice monthly

• 13th-month pay

• Paid trial week at the normal prorated rate

• Long-term role and salary review after six months



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word PERSISTENT.



Answer briefly:

1. Have you worked a night shift before? How long, and doing what?

2. Describe your internet provider, speed, and backup connection.

3. How would you check whether a Florida property has open code-enforcement liens and what is required to clear them?

4. What is one responsibility you owned end-to-end in a previous job?

5. What skill, tool, or system could you bring that would improve this operation?



Also send:

• Your resume

• A 60–90 second voice-sample link

• In the voice sample, introduce yourself, answer question 3 aloud, and read:



“Good afternoon, my name is [name] and I’m a non-attorney assistant calling on behalf of Lien Resolution Corp. I’m following up on a code enforcement case at 147 Marine Street. We’re trying to confirm whether there’s an open lien on the property and what’s needed to clear it. Could you tell me the current status and confirm what documentation you need from us?”

title: AI Developer (Claude, Supabase, Internal Systems)
description:
ABOUT



Spark Marketing Agency runs Meta ads for home service contractors across the US, including roofing, remodeling, landscaping, pools, siding, and HVAC. We manage around 150 client accounts across three teams, supported by an in-house video crew and clients who have generated over one million dollars from our campaigns.



Everything the agency does runs on software we built ourselves. One unified dashboard handles our sales pipeline, client delivery, payroll, the client portal, and roughly 500 backend functions. AI is not a side project here. It drafts media strategies, scores calls, writes content, answers questions about our internal data, and texts clients the moment a lead comes in.



THE ROLE



You build and run that system. We do not build prototypes or demos. You will build software our internal team uses every day and that our clients receive communications from. You will ship to production during your first week, and you will own what you ship.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



* Build features end to end, including Postgres schemas, backend functions, and the interfaces the team actually uses.

* Put AI where it earns its place. Draft prompts, select models, handle edge cases and failures, and evaluate output quality. Anthropic Claude and OpenAI models are both in daily production use here.

* Design and maintain a Supabase Postgres database with over 400 existing migrations, handling row level security, indexes, and maintaining strict data integrity.

* Own scheduled background jobs, retries, outbox queues, and monitoring systems so silent failures are caught immediately.

* Work directly with operations. Observe how CSMs, media buyers, and closers operate daily, and remove manual steps that slow them down.

* Verify your own work thoroughly. Load the page, inspect the logs, check provider records, and ensure systems perform in real conditions before considering a task complete.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



* Proven backend engineering experience. You are proficient with SQL, understand indexing deeply, and have hands-on experience debugging production environments.

* Practical experience integrating LLM APIs in production beyond standard chat interfaces, including robust prompt engineering and error handling.

* Hands-on experience with Supabase or Postgres, including schema migrations, security policies, and performance tuning.

* Strong proficiency in JavaScript or TypeScript on Node, with enough React experience to build functional frontend views for backend services.

* Solid computer science foundation, whether acquired through formal education or self-directed study, reflected in clean problem-solving and system architecture.

* Experience building internal tools, operations software, or automating core business workflows is strongly preferred.



HOURS AND DETAILS



* Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Pacific Time. These working hours are firm because you will collaborate directly with our team in real time, not asynchronously.

* Compensation: Please include your expected monthly salary rate with your application.

* Location: Fully remote, full-time independent contractor engagement.

* Structure: You will report directly to Cesar. Feedback is direct, decisions are fast, and you will take genuine ownership of what you build.

title: Remote Video Editor — Vertical Short-Form Content
description:
About the Role



Aonic is looking for a remote video editor to support our social media content, primarily fast-turnaround vertical short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is an editing-focused role: you'll take raw footage and briefs from our creative producer and turn them into polished, scroll-stopping social content on quick timelines.



Responsibilities



- Edit vertical short-form videos (9:16) from raw footage: talking-head, event coverage, skits, and athlete content etc.

- Deliver fast-turnaround cuts without sacrificing quality

- Add captions, pacing, sound design, and light color/audio cleanup

- Cut multiple hook/variation options from a single piece of footage when needed

- Quickly turn around revisions based on feedback/notes

- At times, act as an assistant editor: process raw footage, identify the best moments/selects, and hand off an organized timeline to the Creative Producer for final editing

- Work from creative briefs and incorporate revision notes efficiently

- Communicate proactively on progress, timelines, and any blockers



Requirements



- Proven experience editing short-form vertical video for social platforms (portfolio/reel required)

- Strong sensitivity to social media editing conventions: hooks, music/sound effect choices, and cutting rhythm/pacing

- Proficiency in editing software, DaVinci Resolve or Premiere preferred 

- Comfortable with fast turnarounds and juggling multiple cuts in flight

- Strong organizational skills for project files, raw footage, and final handoffs, with consistent communication to keep the Creative Producer updated on status and timelines.

- Excellent communication skills: responsive, clear about status/timelines, comfortable giving and receiving feedback async

- Reliable internet and own editing setup (computer/hard drive)



Nice to Have



- Experience editing videos that have gone viral or performed well on social media

- Comfortable using and familiar with AI tools

- Experience editing for wellness, fitness, or nutrition brands

- Motion graphics / Fusion / VFX experience

title: Video Prep Assistant – Clip Editing & Organization (BEGINNERS WELCOME)
description:
We are looking for a reliable Video Prep Assistant to help find, download, trim, and organize video clips and other visual materials for ongoing projects.



BEGINNERS ARE WELCOME! You do not need years of professional experience. We care more about your ability to follow instructions, research efficiently, choose the RIGHT clips, and complete assignments accurately.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

You will be given information and instructions for each project. Your job will be to find and prepare the visual materials we need.



Responsibilities include:

* Searching online for specific video clips

* Finding relevant interviews, news clips, social media clips, and other requested footage

* Downloading videos

* Finding the exact portions of videos that are relevant to the assignment

* Trimming clips to remove unnecessary sections

* Checking completed clips to make sure no profanity was missed

* Censoring profanity in clips by muting or bleeping curse words without removing important dialogue

* Finding photos, screenshots, articles, or other visual materials when requested

* Clearly naming and organizing files

* Organizing everything so it is ready to use

* Making sure all requested materials are included before submitting the project



THIS IS A PREP POSITION

This is NOT advanced video editing.

You will not receive or edit our voiceover recordings.

Your job is to prepare the clips and visual materials that will later be used to create the finished project.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You should be:

Excellent at following instructions

Good at online research

Detail-oriented

Organized

Reliable and dependable

Able to work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

Comfortable receiving feedback

Available consistently

Interested in ongoing work



Basic video editing skills are helpful because you will need to download, trim, and censor clips.



TEST

Applicants who appear to be a good fit will be given a short test assignment. The test will involve finding and preparing clips according to specific instructions.



HOW TO APPLY

Please include:

1. Your name

2. Your experience with video editing, online research, or finding online content

3. What video editing software you use

4. How many hours you are generally available each day

5. Your typical availability Monday–Sunday

6. Whether you are comfortable searching online to locate very specific clips

7. Pay rate is $2 per project, Do you accept the rate?

8. Please put “VIDEO PREP” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire job post.

title: Creative Marketer & Media Buyer: Video Editing, Ad Creative, Meta Ads (Lead Gen, UK Hours)
description:
We run paid lead generation for clients across the UK and US, and for our own brands. Meta ads, automated lead routing, leads sold on a per-lead basis. When the ads work, we get paid. When they don't, we don't. That's the whole business.



Which makes creative the single biggest lever we have. New angles, new hooks, new edits, constantly. That's what this role is really about: making the ads, and then running them.



Read this part carefully, because it's the thing most applicants get wrong. 



We already have systems. 



Prompt libraries, creative frameworks, script templates, SOPs. 



We are not hiring someone to invent a process from scratch, and we're not hiring someone who quietly ignores ours and does it their own way. 



We're hiring someone who runs our systems fast, spots where they're weak, and makes them better. 



Editing is time-intensive by nature, and the whole point of the systems is that you don't do it the slow way. 



If you'd rather build everything manually because that's how you've always done it, this will frustrate both of us.



What you'll actually do



Creative (most of your week)



Edit short-form video ads at volume: UGC-style edits, talking-head cuts, b-roll, captions, hook variations. Multiple finished ads a week, every week.



Write the scripts behind them. Hooks, angles, the whole thing. 



Scripts that sound like a person talking, not a brochure.



Write ad copy: primary text, headlines, variations worth testing.



Produce static image ads and thumbnails.



Use AI creative tools properly. AI video generation, AI voice, Claude and ChatGPT for scripting and copy. 



This is core to how we produce, not a novelty. You should already be writing your own prompts and getting usable output, not pasting in "write me an ad" and hoping.



Build a real testing rhythm: fresh hooks weekly, kill what's dead, iterate on what's working.



Media buying (the other half)



Launch, monitor and adjust Meta campaigns daily. Budgets, audiences, creative testing, scaling winners, cutting losers.



Connect the two halves. 



You made the ad, so you own whether it worked, and you change the next one accordingly.



Report daily on spend, CPL and lead quality, and come to the call with a view on what to change.

Hard requirements



Genuinely strong short-form video editing. This is the core of the job. You'll send us examples and we will watch them properly.



Script and copywriting ability. You can take a brief and turn out a hook and a script that reads naturally to a British or American audience.



Speed. Volume matters here. A beautiful ad a fortnight is no use to us.



Hands-on Meta ads experience. You should be able to talk about a campaign you ran, what it cost, what it produced, and what you changed when it stopped working.



AI tools in your daily workflow. Claude, ChatGPT, AI video and voice tools. We'll ask how you actually use them.



You follow systems. You can pick up someone else's SOP, run it accurately at speed, and improve it rather than replace it.



Strong written English. You're writing ads for UK and US audiences. Clunky copy is an instant no.



A big plus (not required)



We're a small team, so the backend matters too. If you also have any of this, say so clearly in your application. It changes what we can pay and how fast you grow here:



n8n, Make or Zapier. Building and maintaining real automations: lead routing, CRM syncs, notifications, reporting.

CRM and lead-flow operations



Tracking and pixel setup, reporting dashboards

Pay-per-lead or lead generation experience

TikTok or Google Ads



None of these are dealbreakers. Creative and media buying come first. The rest is upside.



What you get



Full-time, remote, long-term. We're building a team, not filling a gap.

Direct access to the founder. No layers, no ticket system.

A tested creative system to work inside, so you're not starting every ad from a blank page.

Paid time off, plus 13th month pay.

Salary reviewed at 3 and 6 months.

Genuine progression. The person who does this well ends up running the creative and media side.



HOW TO APPLY (this is the filter, don't soften it)



Applications that skip any step below get deleted unread. Please don't waste your time or ours.



1. Put this word at the start of your subject line: T-SHAPED



2. Send us a 30-second video of yourself. Loom, an unlisted YouTube link, or Google Drive, whatever's easiest. Just talk to camera and tell us who you are and what you're good at.



No video, no application. This is the first thing we look at.



3. Send us three short-form video ads you personally edited. 



4. Attach your CV, plus screenshots or a portfolio showing ads you ran and the Ads Manager results.



5. Tell us your expected monthly rate in PHP and your available start date.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test task, a real edit from one of our briefs, before any interview. 



We pay for the test.

title: Senior Influencer Marketing & Creator Outreach Manager
description:
Tentative START DATE: September 28, 2026



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Clyn Co is a US skincare brand selling premium disposable face towels on Amazon.



We are hiring a full-time Influencer Marketing and Creator Outreach Manager to build and manage our US creator pipeline from discovery through published content.



The initial focus is identifying US-based creators in:

* Beauty

* Skincare

* Wellness

* Lifestyle

* Personal care

* Relevant adjacent categories



Campaigns will include a defined mix of creator tiers, including nano, micro, mid-tier and macro influencers. The required follower ranges and mix will be established for each campaign.



Collaborations may include:

* Gifted products

* Paid content

* Affiliate commissions

* Performance-based compensation

* Approved combinations of these structures



This is not a social media posting or content-production role. You will own creator sourcing, vetting, outreach, negotiation, follow-up, campaign coordination and performance tracking.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

* Creator discovery and sourcing

* Creator qualification and vetting

* Personalized outreach

* Follow-up communication

* Negotiation within approved compensation limits

* Creator onboarding

* Collection of shipping and campaign information

* Coordination with the company on product shipments

* Tracking creator agreements and deliverables

* Monitoring content deadlines

* Following up on overdue content

* Recording published content

* Tracking creator and campaign performance

* Maintaining the complete influencer pipeline

* Building long-term relationships with high-performing creators



CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

* Find qualified US-based creators across the company’s defined creator tiers

* Evaluate each creator’s audience, engagement, content quality and brand fit

* Send personalized outreach through
, Instagram, TikTok or other approved channels

* Follow up consistently on every open conversation

* Present collaboration terms clearly

* Negotiate gifted, paid, affiliate and commission-based collaborations within approved limits

* Confirm creator deliverables, deadlines, compensation and usage rights

* Collect shipping information and coordinate product fulfillment with the company

* Ensure creators receive the product and understand the campaign requirements

* Track content due dates and follow up before deadlines

* Confirm that sponsored or gifted content includes required disclosures

* Record content links and available performance data

* Identify creators who should be retained, expanded or discontinued

* Maintain accurate campaign and pipeline records

* Escalate compensation, claims or contract exceptions to the Founder



CREATOR VETTING REQUIREMENTS



Every recommended creator must be evaluated for:

* Fit with The Clyn Co customer

* US audience concentration

* Relevant beauty, skincare, wellness, lifestyle or personal-care content

* Creator tier and follower count

* Recent median video views

* Engagement rate and engagement quality

* Authenticity of comments

* Posting consistency

* Audience demographics when available

* Evidence of fake, inactive or irrelevant followers

* Quality of previous sponsored content

* Frequency of sponsored content

* Brand safety

* Likelihood of accepting the proposed collaboration

* Quality of content the brand could potentially reuse



Follower count alone does not qualify a creator.



OUTREACH REQUIREMENTS

* Send 50 to 100 new personalized outreach messages each week

* Add 20 to 30 newly sourced and fully vetted creators to the tracker each week

* Follow up on every open creator conversation

* Avoid generic copy-and-paste outreach

* Personalize outreach based on the creator’s content, audience or relevant recent post

* Test different outreach messages and offers

* Track reply rates by message, platform, creator tier and offer type

* Use results to improve future outreach



WEEKLY DELIVERABLES

* 20 to 30 newly sourced and vetted creators

* 50 to 100 personalized outreach messages

* Follow-ups completed on every open conversation

* Creator tracker fully updated

* Overdue deliverables followed up

* Weekly pipeline report showing:

  * Creators sourced

  * Creators vetted

  * Outreach sent

  * Replies received

  * Interested creators

  * Negotiations underway

  * Creators agreed

  * Products awaiting shipment

  * Products shipped

  * Content due

  * Content delivered

  * Content published

  * Overdue deliverables

  * Creators declined or disqualified



MONTHLY DELIVERABLES

* Agreed number of signed creators

* Creator performance log

* Published content links

* Deliverable completion status

* Cost, gifting and commission details

* Available performance results for each creator

* Analysis of which creator tiers performed best

* Analysis of which outreach messages and offers performed best

* Recommendation on creators to retain or expand

* Recommendation for improving the following month’s outreach and campaign strategy



INFLUENCER TOOLS AND SYSTEMS

You should have experience with influencer discovery, audience analysis, outreach and campaign-tracking tools.



Relevant platforms may include:

* Instagram

* TikTok

* TikTok Creator Marketplace

* Amazon Creator Connections

* Modash

* HypeAuditor

* GRIN

* Upfluence

* Heepsy

* Collabstr

* Shopify Collabs

* Similar influencer marketing platforms

* Spreadsheets, databases or CRM tools used to manage creator pipelines



The company can pay for an approved platform. You will be expected to recommend the appropriate tools based on functionality, cost and campaign requirements.



Do not recommend an expensive platform unless its capabilities materially improve creator discovery, vetting, outreach or campaign management.



YOU WILL NOT OWN

* Organic posting on The Clyn Co social accounts

* The brand’s organic social media strategy

* Creating graphics or videos

* Paid social media advertising

* Setting the maximum compensation offer

* Approving product claims

* Making unapproved changes to campaign terms



The company defines the creator tiers, campaign targets and compensation ceiling. You negotiate within the approved parameters.



Creators produce their own campaign content. The Designer produces brand-owned creative.



If a campaign requires a brand-created asset, submit the request to the Senior Social Media Manager. Do not assign work directly to the Designer.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

* Direct experience managing influencer or creator campaigns

* Experience sourcing US creators on Instagram and TikTok

* Experience with gifted, paid, affiliate and commission-based collaborations

* Strong personalized outreach writing

* Negotiation experience

* Ability to evaluate engagement and audience quality

* Experience identifying fake or low-quality engagement

* Experience managing creator follow-ups and deadlines

* Strong spreadsheet, database or CRM skills

* Experience tracking creator deliverables and campaign status

* Ability to analyze campaign and creator performance

* Professional written and spoken English

* Strong organization and attention to detail

* Reliable communication and follow-through

* Reliable computer, smartphone and internet connection



PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

* Beauty, skincare, wellness or personal-care campaigns

* Amazon or ecommerce brands

* Amazon Creator Connections

* TikTok Shop or affiliate programs

* Experience with influencer-discovery and audience-analysis tools

* Tracking content usage rights

* Managing product-seeding campaigns

* Building long-term creator relationships

* Experience working with early-stage consumer brands



WORKING HOURS AND COMMUNICATION

* Full-time schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Philippine Time, including a one-hour lunch

* Required live availability: Monday through Thursday, 8:00 p.m. to 12:00 midnight US Eastern Time

* This corresponds to Tuesday through Friday mornings in the Philippines

* You must remain online and accessible for questions, feedback and ad-hoc discussions throughout this four-hour window

* You must be available for scheduled 30-minute 1:1 meetings with the Founder and team calls as needed during this window

* The four-hour availability window is not four hours of meetings. The remaining time is normal working time

* You must submit a written end-of-day report before finishing your Philippine workday



YOUR EOD REPORT MUST INCLUDE

1. Creators sourced

2. Creators vetted

3. New outreach messages sent

4. Follow-ups completed

5. Replies received

6. Creators moved to a new pipeline stage

7. Collaboration terms agreed

8. Products awaiting shipment or shipped

9. Content delivered, published or overdue

10. Problems, delays or decisions needed

11. Priorities for the next workday

12. Negotiations or approvals requiring Founder attention



HOW SUCCESS WILL BE MEASURED

* Number and quality of creators sourced

* Outreach reply rate

* Number of qualified creators signed

* Cost per signed creator

* Time required to move creators through the pipeline

* Percentage of signed creators who deliver content

* Percentage of content delivered on time

* Quality and brand fit of creator content

* Performance of completed collaborations

* Accuracy of the creator tracker

* Effectiveness of follow-up communication

* Ability to build repeat relationships with high-performing creators



TO APPLY



Your subject line must be:



CLYN CREATOR - [Your First Name]



Include all of the following:



1. Describe two influencer campaigns you personally managed.

For each campaign, include:

* Product category

* Creator tiers

* Number of creators sourced

* Outreach volume

* Reply rate

* Creators signed

* Collaboration structure

* Content-delivery rate

* Campaign results

* Your exact responsibilities

2. Describe your experience with:

* Gifted collaborations

* Paid collaborations

* Affiliate commissions

* Performance-based compensation

* Product-seeding campaigns

3. Provide a complete influencer-tool proficiency table.

For every tool, include:

* Tool name

* Years of experience

* Proficiency level: Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced or Expert

* How frequently you use it

* What you use it for

* Number of campaigns or creators managed with it

* Whether you currently have paid access

4. Recommend the tools you would use for The Clyn Co.

Explain:

* Which tools you recommend

* What each tool would be used for

* Creator-discovery capabilities

* Audience and engagement-analysis capabilities

* Outreach and follow-up capabilities

* Campaign-tracking capabilities

* Important limitations

* Estimated subscription level required

* Why the cost is justified

5. Identify three US creators you believe could fit a premium disposable face-towel brand.

The creators should represent different creator tiers. For each creator, provide:

* Profile link

* Creator category

* Follower count

* Recent median views

* Engagement assessment

* US audience evidence, if available

* Why the creator fits the brand

* Recommended gifted, paid, affiliate or commission-based approach

6. Write one personalized outreach message for one of the three creators.

7. Explain your method for detecting fake followers and low-quality engagement.

8. Provide a redacted example of an influencer campaign tracker or pipeline you personally managed, if available.

9. Confirm that you can work the stated Philippine schedule and remain available during the required US Eastern collaboration window.

10. Confirm that you can start on September 28, 2026.



Generic applications without campaign evidence will not be reviewed.



Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid creator-sourcing and outreach test.

title: Creative Strategist — DTC Meta/TikTok Ads (Strategy Role, NOT Video Editing)
description:
READ THIS LINE FIRST: This is a STRATEGY role, not a video editing role. If your portfolio is mainly edited videos or design work, this is not the job for you and we will not consider the application. We are hiring the person who d
 what gets made and why, then briefs it out.



ABOUT US



Nicebeam is a US DTC brand selling at-home beauty devices — red light therapy panels and EMS facial lifting tools. Our core customer is a woman in the US aged 40 to 60 who cares about firmness, fine lines, sagging along the jaw, and skin texture. She is not the "get ready with me" TikTok audience. We acquire customers on Meta and TikTok.



We are looking for one person to own creative performance: research, angles, hooks, scripts, briefs, and the testing system that d
 what scales and what gets killed.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Research. Competitor ad libraries, customer reviews, and our own account data. Work out which angles are winning in the beauty-device category and why.

- Angles and hooks. Develop new angles from real customer pain points. Write the first three seconds.

- Creative briefs. Turn each angle into a brief an editor can execute without asking questions — shot list, pacing, on-screen text, CTA.

- The testing system. D
 what gets tested, at what budget, against what bar. Kill losers fast, iterate winners.

- Reporting. Tell me every week what won, what died, and what you are testing next — in numbers, not adjectives.



Hands-on work is part of this job but it is not the job. You will build static ads and simple edits yourself in Canva/CapCut and use AI tools to spin variations quickly. Heavier video production gets briefed out to an editor.



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You have run creative for at least one DTC brand with real Meta or TikTok spend behind it, and you can talk about specific numbers you were responsible for.

- You have a point of view on hook rate, hold rate, CTR and ROAS thresholds — and you can say what bar you hold creatives to and why.

- You write native-sounding English. Hooks and scripts are written in English for a US audience; this is a writing job as much as a visual one.

- You work without being managed. This is a small team and you will work directly with me, the founder. Nobody will be checking whether your tasks got done.



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



- Video editors or graphic designers looking for a strategist title

- Anyone who cannot point to a real ad account they worked in

- Anyone who needs someone else to write the brief for them



COMPENSATION



Base: $1,700–2,400/month, 40 hrs/week, depending on experience.



Performance bonus, paid on top of base, per winning creative:

- $150 when a creative you conceived reaches $5,000 cumulative Meta/TikTok spend at ROAS 1.6x or better

- $400 when that same creative reaches $15,000 cumulative spend at ROAS 1.6x or better

- $1,200 when that same creative reaches $50,000 cumulative spend at ROAS 1.6x or better



Tiers stack per creative — one creative that reaches $50K earns $1,750 in total. Paid monthly. Attribution comes straight from the ad account and I will show you the numbers.



HOW TO APPLY



Answer these three questions in your message. Short answers are fine — specific answers are required. Applications that skip them are deleted unread.



1. Name one DTC brand you ran creative for, roughly how much monthly ad spend sat behind your creatives, and one angle you developed that worked. Why did it work?



2. You have $500 to test new creatives this week. How many do you launch, and what are your exact kill and scale rules?



3. Pick any at-home beauty device brand, look at its ads in the Meta Ad Library, and tell me one angle it is using and one angle it is missing. Two or three sentences.



Then send:

- A link to your portfolio or work samples. Briefs, scripts and angle docs are more useful to me than finished videos.

- A screenshot of any ad account you have worked in. Redact the brand name if you need to.



Shortlisted candidates get a paid $50 test task (about 4 hours) before any offer is made.

title: Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services
description:
Inbound Sales Representative – Home Services



We are looking for an experienced sales representative to join our team and sell home services to inbound leads.



This is not an entry-level sales position. We are looking for someone who already knows how to speak with homeowners, understand their needs, build trust quickly, overcome objections, follow up consistently, and close deals.



You will be speaking with customers who have already expressed interest in our services. Your job is to turn those opportunities into booked and paid jobs.



Responsibilities

Respond quickly to inbound phone, web, and other leads

Speak with homeowners about their project and understand exactly what they need

Explain our services and pricing clearly

Build trust and confidently guide customers toward purchasing

Handle common objections around price, timing, competitors, and project details

Follow up with leads who do not purchase immediately

Keep accurate notes and update lead statuses in our CRM

Meet sales and conversion targets

Communicate with the operations team when needed to ensure a smooth customer experience

Requirements

Previous sales experience is required

Strong preference for experience selling home services, construction, HVAC, landscaping, roofing, plumbing, electrical, cleaning, junk removal, materials, or similar services

Proven ability to close inbound leads

Excellent spoken and written English

Confident and natural on the phone

Strong objection-handling and follow-up skills

Comfortable discussing pricing and asking for the sale

Organized and able to manage multiple leads simultaneously

Reliable internet connection and professional working environment

Comfortable using CRMs, phone systems,
, and messaging tools

What We're Looking For



We want someone who thinks like a salesperson, not an order taker.



A good candidate understands that an inbound inquiry is an opportunity that needs to be worked. You should be comfortable asking questions, identifying what matters to the customer, addressing concerns, creating urgency when appropriate, and directly asking the customer to move forward.



Experience and results matter more to us than formal education.



REQUIRED: Video Introduction



Applications without a video will not be considered.



Please submit a 2–3 minute video recording introducing yourself and answering the following:



Tell us about your previous sales experience.

What products or services have you sold?

Have you sold home services or worked with homeowners before?

Were the leads inbound, outbound, or both?

What were your typical sales targets or results?

Give us an example of how you would respond to a customer who says, "Your price is too high. I need to think about it."

Why do you think you would be good at this role?



Please speak naturally. We are using the video primarily to evaluate your communication skills, English, confidence, and sales ability, not your video production skills.



How to Apply



Send us:



Your resume

Your video introduction

A short description of your most relevant sales experience

The types of products or services you have sold

Any sales numbers, close rates, quotas, or other performance metrics you can share



Again, sales experience and the video introduction are mandatory. Applications without both will be automatically rejected.

title: Housecall Pro specialist
description:

title: All-Star Graphic Designer
description:
BridgeCare ABA is looking for an exceptionally talented graphic designer to become our in-house go-to for anything visual.



We have one main standard: whatever we give you, you should be able to make it look really, really good.



That could be a business card one day, a large banner the next, followed by an ad, flyer, employee announcement, social graphic, presentation, brochure, or something completely different.



We’ll provide the goal, content, brand guidelines, and direction. We don’t want to have to design it for you. We want someone with the skill and design judgment to take what we give them and turn it into an exceptional finished product.



What we’re looking for

An outstanding portfolio across different types of design

Exceptional typography, layout, spacing, composition, and visual hierarchy

Ability to execute a specific vision extremely well

Strong digital and print design experience

Ability to adapt to very different types of projects

Extremely strong attention to detail

Ability to take feedback and turn around revisions quickly

Someone we can trust to handle the execution without constant supervision

Your degree and years of experience matter far less to us than how good your work actually is.



How we work

We care about results, quality, and speed, not whether you’re sitting in front of a screen every minute of the day.

We don’t believe in screen monitoring, unnecessary check-ins, or babysitting talented people. If your work is excellent, your communication is reliable, and projects get completed quickly, you’ll have a lot of freedom and flexibility in how you structure your day.

We want someone we can give a project to and trust that it will come back looking exceptional.



A note about AI

We do not care what tools you use. Adobe, Figma, Canva, AI tools, or anything else are all fine.

What we care about is the final result.

We strongly dislike the generic, obvious “AI-generated” look that many image generators produce. If you rely heavily on AI-generated visuals and your work tends to have that look, this is probably not the right role for you.

We want work that feels intentional, polished, natural, and professionally designed.



The role

Full-time | Long-term

Compensation: $500-$1,200 USD/month, depending on skill, experience, and portfolio quality. 



We are willing to pay at the top of the range for an exceptional designer.



Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a paid design test using real examples of the type of work we need.



To apply

Send your portfolio, resume, desired monthly salary, and availability.

Your portfolio is the most important part of your application.

title: U.S. Bookkeeping & Accounting Professional
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Philippines | U.S. Hours



Immediate Opening



We are looking for a full-time accounting professional in the Philippines who wants to build a long-term career working with U.S.-based clients.



This position is a little different from a typical bookkeeping role, so please read the entire description before applying.



What the Role Looks Like



For the first 1 to 3 months, a significant part of this position will involve high-volume data entry for one U.S. client.



This client processes a large number of transactions, potentially 50 to 100+ invoices per day, across both accounts payable and accounts receivable. You need to be comfortable working accurately and efficiently with this level of volume.



We want to be very clear about this upfront. If you dislike repetitive, high-volume transaction entry, this probably isn't the right position for you.



However, the position will not stay this way.



We are actively working to automate much of this process. Sales and AR activity will eventually flow from ServiceTitan into the accounting system, and AP invoices will increasingly be processed using OCR and automation tools.



As those systems are implemented, your role will shift from primarily entering transactions to reviewing transactions, monitoring automated processes, bookkeeping, reconciliations, and working with additional U.S. clients.



Our expectation is that this position will eventually support approximately 3 to 5 U.S. clients, starting with our less complicated accounts. As your skills and knowledge grow, there will be opportunities to take on more complex accounting responsibilities.



What We're Looking For



We would especially like to hear from candidates who have:



* Experience working directly with U.S.-based clients, preferably multiple clients

* Strong experience with QuickBooks Online

* Experience with bookkeeping, bank reconciliations, AP and AR

* Experience processing a high volume of invoices or other financial transactions

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* The ability to work efficiently with repetitive tasks without sacrificing quality

* Good written and verbal English communication skills

* A reliable, high-speed internet connection and dependable home work environment

* An interest in learning new accounting systems and technology

* A genuine interest in working with and eventually supporting multiple U.S. businesses



Experience with ServiceTitan would be a major plus, but it is not required.



Work Schedule



This is a full-time, 8-hour-per-day position working U.S. hours.



Your regular workday will end at 2:00 AM Pacific Time, so please make sure you are comfortable working this schedule on a long-term basis before applying.



We strongly prefer candidates who have previously worked a night or graveyard schedule for U.S. clients and already know that this schedule works for them.



Where This Position Can Go



We're not looking for someone just to enter invoices.



We're looking for someone who can handle the high-volume work required at the beginning, learn our clients and systems, and then grow into a broader accounting and bookkeeping role.



As we automate the repetitive work, we want to give you more responsibility and expose you to additional U.S. clients. For someone who wants to develop their U.S. accounting experience, there is significant room to grow.



How to Apply



Please submit both of the following:



1. Your resume

2. A short video introduction, approximately 1 minute



In your video, please briefly tell us:



* Your accounting/bookkeeping background

* How much experience you have working with U.S. clients

* The highest volume of invoices or transactions you've handled

* Whether you've previously worked a U.S. night/graveyard schedule

* Why you're interested in working with more U.S.-based clients



Applications without both a resume and video will not be considered.

You will NOT be responsible for closing the sale. Your job is to create qualified opportunities and get interested property owners onto our calendar.



We will also teach you our lead-sourcing process so you can eventually find and contact your own prospects. Self-sourced leads that become clients will earn a higher bonus.



We currently manage 5 properties, with another 2–4 expected to onboard soon, and we are actively growing.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



• Contact property owners from our existing lead database

• Make outbound calls to potential clients

• Send follow-up messages and
s

• Respond to interested prospects

• Qualify property owners based on our criteria

• Book qualified sales calls on our calendar

• Keep lead statuses, notes, and follow-ups organized in our CRM

• Work inside GoHighLevel (GHL) as our sales automation system is built out

• Eventually source and prospect your own leads

• Help us improve scripts and outreach based on what you're hearing from prospects



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



You do NOT need previous vacation rental experience.



We care much more about your ability to communicate, sell, follow up, and stay organized.



Strong candidates may have experience in:



• Cold calling

• Appointment setting

• Outbound sales

• Telemarketing

• BPO / call centers

• Retention

• Collections

• Real estate prospecting

• Lead generation



You should:



• Speak clear, conversational English

• Be comfortable hearing "no" and continuing

• Be persistent with follow-up

• Be able to work independently

HOURS

There is room for additional hours and responsibility as the company grows.

title: Shopify Brand Operator (Full-Time , Remote , Philippines)
description:
Job Overview

- This is a process-driven e-commerce operator role focused on day-to-day Shopify D2C storefront execution and fulfillment operations across one or more consumer-product brands. The role is operational rather than strategic, with emphasis on structured workflows, recurring reporting, 3PL/supplier coordination, and early escalation of exceptions.



What You Will Do?

- Storefront Management: Maintain Shopify product listings, collections, variants, product descriptions, media assets, Metafields, and store navigation.

- App & Tech Stack Maintenance: Monitor app integrations (subscriptions, upsells, reviews, inventory sync), store health, broken links, and checkout workflows.

- Inventory & Fulfillment Ops: Track stock levels across warehouses/3PLs, monitor inbound supplier shipments, manage stockout risks, reorder points, and Shopify location inventory.

- 3PL & Supplier Coordination: Coordinate with international suppliers, freight partners, 3PL fulfillment centers, and designers using approved templates.

- Promotions & Site Updates: Setup and schedule discounts, automatic promo codes, landing pages, gift-with-purchase setups, and price adjustments.

- Performance Monitoring: Track daily site revenue, conversion rate (CVR), average order value (AOV), refund/return rates, customer support tickets, and traffic trends.

- Reporting & Documentation: Build clear weekly reporting inside Notion or Google Sheets.

- Helpdesk & Issue Escalation: Create support cases with Shopify Support / app developers, document outcomes, and maintain task queues.

- Competitor & Conversion Sourcing: Execute competitor CRO research and catalog optimization using approved tools and templates.

- Flag Exceptions: Surface risks involving inventory shortages, 3PL delays, theme bugs, material supplier issues, or elevated refund trends early.



What We Are Looking For?



a. Required

- Based in the Philippines and seeking a long-term remote role.

- 2+ years of hands-on Shopify Admin & D2C E-Commerce experience.

- Experience managing Shopify product catalogs, variants, collections, and order management workflows.

- Familiarity with 3PL fulfillment operations, inventory tracking, and carrier shipping logistics.

- Working knowledge of core D2C e-commerce metrics: CVR, AOV, ROAS, LTV, Refund Rate, and Traffic.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

- Strong written English and professional supplier/partner communication.

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to follow SOPs precisely.

- Strong file organization, naming, documentation, and task-management habits.

- Comfortable working in Notion, ClickUp, Asana, or similar tools.

- Reliable internet, a suitable work computer, and dependable availability.



b. Nice To Have

- Experience with Shopify Theme Editors, PageFly, GemPages, or Shogun.

- Experience with 3PL portals (Flexport, ShipBob, Stord, ShipMonk) or inventory management apps.

- Experience managing subscription tools (Recharge, Seal) or customer service helpdesks (Gorgias, Zendesk).

- Basic HTML/CSS knowledge or light Liquid troubleshooting skills.Basic image-editing, Canva, or Photoshop skills.

- Experience coordinating international suppliers or freight forwarders via Alibaba/WhatsApp. 



c. This Role Is Not For You If...

- You want to set brand strategy, select new products, or negotiate commercial terms independently.

- You are uncomfortable following structured SOPs and approval rules.

- You make pricing, inventory, supplier, or app subscription changes without confirming authority.

- You dislike documentation, checklists, and recurring reporting.

- You need frequent live supervision to complete routine work.

- You plan to manage several competing full-time clients simultaneously.



d. What Success Looks Like?

- Shopify product pages, inventory levels, app setups, and weekly reporting are kept current without reminders.

- Potential stockouts, 3PL delays, store bugs, and supplier issues are surfaced early.

- Every operational task has a clean status, owner, documentation trail, and next action.

- Escalations arrive with the problem, supporting data, a recommended action, and an alternative considered.

- Operational consistency is maintained without making unapproved strategy changes independently.



How To Apply?

Please submit one application containing:

- A short introduction describing your Shopify store management experience.

- A list of the Shopify/ecommerce tasks you have personally owned.

- The brand niches or markets you have worked in. 

- Your expected monthly salary in USD.  Your current computer specifications. 

- Your internet-speed-test result. 

- A short Loom video, up to 3 minutes, walking through a Shopify operations workflow or 3PL/inventory process you have managed. 

- Two examples of Shopify-related work you can describe without sharing confidential client information.  



Required Qualifying Question:

In 3–5 sentences, explain your exact process when you discover that a top-selling product on Shopify is at risk of going out of stock within 21 days across your 3PL warehouses.



Applications that do not answer the qualifying question will not be considered.

title: Earned Value / Project Controls Analyst
description:
Position summary

LKD Corp is seeking an Earned Value / Project Controls Analyst to own the data pipeline that turns Primavera P6 schedule exports into executive-ready progress curves and earned value reporting inside ChameLeon, our project controls platform. This role sits at the intersection of scheduling data and client-facing reporting: you will take raw P6 data dumps, structure and validate them, load them into ChameLeon, and produce the progress curves and earned value metrics that our clients rely on to understand project health.

This is a hands-on analyst role for someone who is comfortable in the weeds of schedule data and equally comfortable explaining what that data means. You will work directly with the Principal on live capital project engagements.

Key responsibilities

• Extract, compile, and validate schedule data from Primavera P6 exports (XER files and tabular data dumps), including activity data, resource and cost loading, WBS structures, and progress records.

• Clean and normalize raw P6 output into the structured format required by ChameLeon, resolving data quality issues such as missing baselines, inconsistent activity coding, and orphaned or duplicated records.

• Build and maintain progress curves (planned, earned, and actual) at project, discipline, and area levels.

• Calculate and quality-check earned value metrics including BCWS, BCWP, ACWP, SV, CV, SPI, CPI, and forecast indicators such as EAC and TCPI.

• Reconcile progress measurement against the approved progress measurement system — rules of credit, weightings, and quantity-based tracking.

• Investigate and explain period-over-period variances, flagging anomalies in the source data before they reach a client deliverable.

• Produce recurring reporting packages and dashboard outputs for client project teams and executive stakeholders.

• Document the data preparation workflow so it is repeatable, auditable, and transferable across projects.

• Provide structured feedback to the ChameLeon development effort on data handling pain points, import failures, and workflow improvements.

Required qualifications

• 3+ years of project controls experience on capital construction, energy, or infrastructure projects.

• Working proficiency in Primavera P6, including exporting and interpreting XER data and understanding schedule structure, logic, and resource/cost loading.

• Demonstrated experience with earned value management, progress measurement systems, and rules of credit.

• Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookup and reference functions, and handling large datasets.

• Strong attention to data integrity, with the judgment to recognize when source data is wrong rather than simply processing it.

• Ability to communicate findings clearly to project managers and executives who are not schedulers.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience on owner-side or owner’s representative engagements.

• Familiarity with cost management systems (SAP, Ecosys, Oracle Unifier, or similar).

• Exposure to Power BI, SQL, or Python for data handling and reporting automation.

• AACE certification (EVP, PSP, CCP) or progress toward one.

• Experience working with quantity-based progress measurement on engineering and construction scopes.

What success looks like

In the first 90 days, this person is independently turning a P6 data dump into a validated set of progress curves in ChameLeon without rework, and is catching data problems before the Principal does.

title: Full-Stack Software Engineer (Product Development)
description:
Position summary

LKD Corp is building ChameLeon, a modular enterprise platform for project controls. The first module delivers earned value management and progress reporting, bridging the gap between specialist scheduling tools such as Primavera P6 and the executive-level project health communication that capital project owners actually need. Additional modules will follow and are designed to operate as one integrated system.

We are seeking a full-stack software engineer to work directly with the founder to take product concepts, domain logic, and design direction and turn them into working, production-quality software. The founder brings deep project controls domain expertise and a clear product vision. You bring the engineering judgment and execution to build it properly.

This is a build-it-right role, not a ticket-taking role. You will have significant influence over architecture, tooling, and technical direction.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product concepts and domain logic described in plain language into well-structured, maintainable application code.

• Build and extend both the frontend interface and the backend services and calculation engine.

• Design and maintain the data model, with correct multi-tenant separation so that each client organization’s project data is reliably isolated.

• Move the platform from local development onto managed cloud hosting, including deployment pipeline, environment configuration, and database provisioning.

• Implement authentication, user management, and role-based permissions appropriate for enterprise clients.

• Build and maintain data import capability for Primavera P6 exports and other project controls data sources.

• Maintain clean module boundaries within a modular monolith architecture so additional modules can be added without destabilizing existing ones.

• Establish and uphold practical engineering standards: version control discipline, testing, code review, backups, and documentation.

• Advise on technical trade-offs in plain language so that business decisions can be made with a clear understanding of the consequences.

Required qualifications

• 4+ years building and shipping production web applications end to end.

• Strong proficiency with a modern JavaScript/TypeScript frontend framework (React preferred) and a backend runtime such as Node.js.

• Solid relational database skills, including schema design, migrations, and query performance (PostgreSQL preferred).

• Experience deploying and operating applications on managed cloud platforms.

• Practical experience implementing authentication, authorization, and multi-tenant data isolation.

• Ability to work from verbal and conceptual direction, ask the right clarifying questions, and propose a sound technical approach without a written specification.

• Clear communication with non-engineers, without condescension and without hiding behind jargon.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience building B2B SaaS products, particularly for enterprise or industrial clients.

• Familiarity with data visualization libraries and building analytical dashboards.

• Exposure to construction, engineering, energy, or project management software.

• Experience parsing structured industry data formats (XER, XML, or similar).

• Comfort operating in an early-stage environment with evolving requirements.

What success looks like

In the first 90 days, ChameLeon is running on hosted infrastructure with working sign-in and secure client data separation, and the founder can describe a feature in conversation and see it built correctly without having to specify it in technical terms.

Working relationship

The founder is deeply involved in product direction and understands the problem domain better than any engineer will on day one. The right candidate is someone who treats that domain knowledge as an asset to draw on, pushes back constructively on technical grounds, and takes ownership of engineering quality.

title: Google Ads Specialist (PPC & LSA)
description:
Company: Tier 1 Clicks 

Location: Remote (U.S. & Canada) 

Job Type: Full-Time Pay: $20–$25/hour depending on experience and skill.

Hourly to start, with the opportunity to move to a salaried role after an initial trial period.



Who We Are

Tier 1 Clicks is a marketing agency built for HVAC and home service contractors. We run paid ads across Google, Meta, LSA, and YouTube, and our in-house call center turns those leads into booked estimates in the client's CRM. Contractors pay us for one thing: appointments that turn into installs. We're a 30+ person remote team and we're building out a dedicated PPC department. This hire is a big part of that.



The Role

You'll own Google Ads (Search, some Bing) and Google Local Services Ads for a book of contractor accounts. Budgets run from a few thousand to $10K+ per month per client, and every dollar has to produce a lead a contractor can sell. On the PPC side you'll build and manage campaigns, run search term hygiene, test copy and landing pages, and manage bids and budgets. On the LSA side you'll handle profile setup and verification, bidding and budget management, lead disputes, and review strategy to keep clients ranking. You'll report on cost per lead and cost per booked appointment, not clicks and impressions.

This is a hands-on role. You'll be in the accounts every day. You'll also help us document how PPC gets done here, so what works on one account gets applied to all of them.

Read this before applying. This is a Google-only role. We already have a Meta team. We're not looking for a generalist who runs "a little of everything" across
, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Google. We want someone who has spent years deep in Google Search and LSA and knows them better than anyone else on our team. If Google Ads is one of five platforms on your resume, this probably isn't the job for you. If it's the one you'd pick to bet your reputation on, keep reading.



What You'll Do

Build, launch, and manage Google Search campaigns for HVAC and home service clients.

Own daily account hygiene: search term reviews, negatives, bid adjustments, budget pacing.

Structure campaigns around what actually makes contractors money (installs, repairs, seasonal services) and cut what doesn't.

Manage Local Services Ads end to end: setup and Google Guaranteed verification, weekly budgets and bidding, disputing bad leads, and pushing review volume so clients hold top placement.

Write and test ad copy. Work with our creative and web team on landing page improvements.

Set up and maintain conversion tracking, including call tracking, so we know which keywords produce real leads.

Hit cost-per-lead and cost-per-appointment targets and flag accounts drifting off target before the client notices.

Deliver clear weekly performance updates the account manager can pass to the client in plain English.

Use automation and AI tools where they make you faster, and manual work where it makes you better. We care about results, not method.

Help build the SOPs and checklists for our PPC department.



What We're Looking For

3+ years where Google Ads was your primary job, not one channel among many. Direct control of budget and results. Agency or lead-gen experience preferred.

You've managed multiple Google accounts at once and can show cost-per-lead improvements you drove, with numbers.

You can talk specifics: match type strategy, Performance Max vs. Search for lead gen, Smart Bidding thresholds, why a campaign's CPL doubled and what you did about it. We'll ask.

Hands-on Local Services Ads experience: you know how ranking works, how to dispute leads, and how to keep a profile from getting throttled.

Strong with search term analysis, negative keyword strategy, bid strategies, and budget pacing.

Comfortable with conversion tracking, Google Tag Manager, GA4, and call tracking platforms (CallRail or similar).

You understand lead gen economics: a cheap click that doesn't call is worthless.

Home services or local service contractor experience is a strong plus.

Google Ads certification is nice. A track record beats it.

Self-driven, organized, and reliable working remotely.



What You Get:

$20–$25/hour based on experience and skill, with a path to a salaried position after your trial period.

Fully remote work with a team that communicates and backs each other up.

Real ownership. You won't be a button-pusher reporting to three layers of managers.

Training and growth in paid media, lead gen, and agency operations. We promote from within.

The chance to help build a department from the ground up.



How to Apply

If Google Search and LSA are your specialty and you can prove you've made them produce leads at a cost that makes sense, we want to see it.

description:
HEALTHCARE CREDENTIALING SPECIALIST

SNF Insurance Contracting & Provider Enrollment

Remote | Full-Time | Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm



ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a detail-oriented credentialing specialist to manage the contracting and enrollment process between our skilled nursing facilities (SNFs) and health insurance companies. This is a full-time remote position (Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm) where precision is everything — a single error in an application can create long-term delays and compliance issues for our facilities.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Complete and submit credentialing applications to health insurance payers on behalf of SNFs

- Gather, review, and organize facility documentation including licenses, COIs, NPIs, TINs, Medicare/Medicaid approvals, surveys, and more

- Track application status, follow up with payers, and resolve outstanding items

- Edit and prepare PDFs and Word documents for submission

- Maintain accurate, organized records of all submitted applications and correspondence

- Communicate updates and flag issues to the internal team promptly



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Prior experience in healthcare credentialing or provider enrollment with insurance companies

- Hands-on experience working with SNFs

- Proficiency reading and interpreting facility documents (state licenses, Certificates of Insurance, NPI numbers, TINs, Medicare certifications, surveys, etc.)

- Advanced skills in editing PDFs and Microsoft Word documents

- Strong written communication in English

- Exceptional attention to detail — you catch your own errors before submission



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Familiarity with major payers (Medicare Advantage, Medicaid managed care, commercial insurers)

- Experience with credentialing portals (CAQH, NaviMedix, payer-specific portals)

- Experience working remotely with a U.S.-based healthcare organization



DOCUMENTS YOU'LL WORK WITH

State Facility License, Certificate of Insurance (COI), NPI, TIN/EIN, Medicare Certification, State/Federal Surveys, Payer Applications, etc.



IMPORTANT — ACCURACY IS NON-NEGOTIABLE

Every detail on a credentialing application must be correct. Incorrect information — even small discrepancies — can result in delayed or denied contracts, billing issues, and long-term operational problems. Candidates who do not demonstrate a strong track record of precision in prior roles will not be considered.

description:
E commerce, CRM, Social Media, AI & Operations Support



The Original Poop Bags® is looking for a proactive and versatile Consumer Sales Admin Assistant to support our Consumer Channel.

This is not a basic data entry role. We need someone who can work across different areas of the business, learn new tools quickly, notice problems, and take ownership from start to finish.

You do not need to be an expert in everything. We are looking for someone who is strong in a few areas and capable of learning the rest.



What You’ll Help With
