title: GoHighLevel Implementation & Client Success Operator
description:
GoHighLevel Implementation & Client Success Operator — Long-Term Growth Role



We are a growing U.S. company that helps residential electricians get found, get trusted, and get hired.



I am looking for one exceptional Philippines-based GoHighLevel operator who can take ownership of new-client technical implementation and grow into client onboarding, operations, and eventually customer success.



This is a real, immediate opening with long-term growth potential.



This role will begin with a paid technical test and client implementation work while our client base grows. My intention is for the right person to grow into a significant part-time and ultimately full-time role and make this their primary professional commitment.



This is NOT a generic VA position.



I want someone who knows GoHighLevel extremely well and can independently configure, troubleshoot, QA, document, and improve sophisticated client systems.



Ideally, you know the technical side of GoHighLevel better than I do.



I want someone I can rely on as the technical authority — not someone waiting for me to explain how every part of GoHighLevel should work.



I am looking for someone who wants to become an important long-term part of the business, not someone looking to complete random tasks or collect another freelance client.



WHAT WE ALREADY HAVE



Our core GoHighLevel system is already built as a snapshot.



It includes:



Client website

Lead capture and routing

Pipelines and forms

SMS/email workflows

Missed-call / instant text-back

Reputation/review-request automation

Conversation AI chatbot

AI voice assistant that answers incoming calls

Other follow-up and client communication automations



You will not be starting from a blank account or designing our entire system from scratch.



Your job is to take our established system, customize it correctly for each new client, test everything thoroughly, identify weaknesses or opportunities for improvement, and help make the system better as we grow.



IMMEDIATE RESPONSIBILITIES



For each new client, your core responsibility will be to own the technical implementation from start to finish, including:



Create and configure the GHL subaccount

Deploy the correct snapshot

Customize the existing website with client branding, services, service areas, phone numbers and business information

Connect and configure domains and DNS when needed

Configure LeadConnector phone/SMS and call forwarding

Prepare and submit U.S. A2P 10DLC registrations

Troubleshoot A2P rejections

Configure and test missed-call / instant text-back

Configure and test review-request automations

Verify forms, calendars, pipelines, notifications and workflows

Verify lead routing and client notifications

Assist with Google Business Profile configuration when needed

Configure and test our Conversation AI chatbot

Configure and test our AI voice/call assistant

Test websites on desktop and mobile

Perform complete end-to-end QA

Fix anything that is not working correctly

Document the completed setup



A client implementation is not complete simply because the snapshot was installed.



I expect you to personally verify that calls, texts, forms, workflows, review requests, AI conversations, lead routing, notifications and the website actually work before handoff.



I want someone who thinks beyond:



“I completed the task.”



and instead asks:



“Does the entire system actually work for the client?”



OUR ONBOARDING PROCESS IS STILL BEING BUILT



Our technical system already exists, but our complete new-client onboarding process is not yet fully documented as an SOP.



Initially, I will personally participate in onboarding and customer success.



One of your early responsibilities will be helping me turn our real-world onboarding process into a clean, repeatable system.



I want someone who can identify exactly what information and access we need from every client, find missing steps and unnecessary friction, create implementation and QA checklists, document exceptions and troubleshooting procedures, and continuously improve the process.



I am looking for someone who brings expertise and judgment to the table.



If you know a better way to configure, automate, test or deploy something, I want you to tell me.



I want the person I hire to eventually know this system so well that I can rely on their technical judgment rather than being the person who has to figure everything out first.



AI & AUTOMATION EXPERIENCE IS IMPORTANT



Our system includes both a GoHighLevel Conversation AI chatbot and an AI voice assistant that answers incoming calls.



Hands-on experience with GoHighLevel Conversation AI and/or Voice AI is strongly preferred.



Relevant experience includes:



AI prompts and instructions

Knowledge bases

Lead qualification

Capturing caller/customer information

Appointment or callback handling

Routing and human handoff

Workflows triggered by AI interactions

Testing AI calls and conversations

Troubleshooting incorrect or unexpected AI responses

Improving prompts and call flows

Monitoring AI performance

Preventing hallucinations or inappropriate responses

Escalating situations appropriately to a human



I want someone who understands that an AI system needs to be configured intelligently, stress-tested, monitored and continually improved.



Experience with additional AI/automation tools such as Vapi, Retell, n8n, Make, Zapier, APIs or webhooks is also valuable.



WHERE THIS ROLE CAN GROW



Initially, I will personally manage client relationships.



However, I want the right person to quickly begin participating in and eventually owning client onboarding.



Over time, I want this person to:



Conduct new-client onboarding calls

Collect everything required to launch a client

Own implementation from onboarding through launch

Maintain and improve SOPs and QA systems

Monitor client accounts for technical problems

Proactively identify issues before clients notice them

Communicate directly with clients

Make routine client-requested changes

Help clients understand and use their system

Monitor and improve AI calls/conversations

Help clients get maximum value from what we provide

Eventually own ongoing client success and retention



The long-term opportunity is to become the person who owns much of what happens after a new client signs up.



I am looking for someone who wants to own a business function, not simply complete assigned tickets.



As our client base grows, I want this role to grow with it and ultimately become the person's primary full-time position.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Please apply only if you already have strong, real-world, hands-on GoHighLevel experience.



I am not looking for someone who recently completed a course and is looking for their first serious GHL opportunity.



Strong candidates should have hands-on experience with many of the following:



GHL subaccounts and snapshots

A2P 10DLC / LeadConnector

Websites and funnels

Workflows and automations

Reputation management / review requests

Missed-call text-back

LC Phone / SMS

Forms and calendars

Pipelines

Domains / DNS

Google Business Profile

Conversation AI

Voice AI

Troubleshooting and QA



Experience with U.S. home-service businesses such as electricians, plumbers, HVAC or roofing is a plus.



Experience with client onboarding, customer success, operations management, RevOps, project management, SOP creation or process improvement is a major plus.



EXCEPTIONAL ENGLISH IS REQUIRED



This role is intended to become highly client-facing.



You must have exceptional spoken and written English and be able to communicate naturally, confidently and professionally with U.S. small-business owners.



You should be comfortable:



Leading Zoom onboarding calls

Speaking naturally without relying on scripts

Building rapport

Asking intelligent follow-up questions

Understanding conversational American English

Explaining technical issues in simple language

Handling confused or frustrated clients calmly

Writing clear, professional
s and messages

Representing our company professionally without me being on the call



Exceptional English communication is mandatory.



Technical ability alone is not enough for this position.



THE PERSON I WANT



I value:



Ownership

Excellent judgment

Deep technical competence

Attention to detail

Reliability

Problem-solving

Proactive thinking

Strong documentation

Exceptional communication

Ability to work independently

Curiosity and continuous improvement

Genuine care about client outcomes



If you discover a problem, I don't want you to simply tell me there is a problem.



I want your instinct to be:



Investigate it → understand it → fix it if possible → test the fix → document what happened → tell me what you did.



And if you see something that could be done better, I expect you to speak up.



IMPORTANT: INDIVIDUAL ROLE / NO SUBCONTRACTING



I am hiring one individual, not an agency.



You must personally perform the work assigned to you.



Do not give our passwords, client information, account access or work to friends, coworkers, agencies or subcontractors without my explicit written permission.



If you encounter something you do not know how to do, be transparent about it.



Asking a question is fine.



Giving an unapproved person access to our systems or client accounts is not.



COMPENSATION & GROWTH



The first technical implementation will be a paid $50 USD test project using our standardized system.



For ongoing standardized client implementations, the current target is $50 per completed client setup.



The initial workload will be lighter while our client base grows.



As responsibilities expand into onboarding calls, AI management, SOP/process ownership, operations and client success, responsibility and compensation will increase accordingly.



The right person can grow into a significant recurring role and ultimately a full-time position as our client base expands.



Quality, ownership, communication and long-term fit matter more to me than finding the lowest-cost applicant.



We are hiring now and will move quickly once we find the right person.



HOW TO APPLY



Please do NOT send me a generic cover letter.



Start your application with:



“I personally perform my GHL work.”



Then answer:



How long have you personally worked inside GoHighLevel, and what types of businesses/accounts have you worked on?

Tell me about the most recent U.S. A2P 10DLC registration you personally completed. Have you handled a rejection? What caused it and how did you resolve it?

Have you personally deployed snapshots into client subaccounts? What do you check after deployment before considering an account ready?

Have you configured review-request workflows and missed-call text-back? What do you test before launch?

Have you built or customized websites/funnels inside GHL?

Have you personally worked with GHL Conversation AI or Voice AI? Explain what you built, what the AI was responsible for, and how you tested it.

Have you conducted onboarding calls or communicated directly with U.S. clients? Describe that experience.

Tell me about one SOP, QA system or business process you personally created or significantly improved.

Tell me about a technical or operational problem you discovered before the client noticed it. What did you do?

Are you currently working for another employer or clients? If yes, approximately how many hours per week?

Do you currently own, operate or work for an agency? If yes, please explain.

If this role grows into full-time work, are you willing to make Automatic For You your primary professional commitment?

What type of role would you ideally like to have two years from now?

VIDEO REQUIRED



Please also send a 3–5 minute Loom video with your camera on.



In the video:



Introduce yourself

Explain one GoHighLevel system you personally built or managed

Explain one difficult technical problem you personally solved

Briefly describe any Conversation AI or Voice AI work you've done

Tell me why this particular long-term role interests you



Do not read from a script.



Speak naturally as if you were explaining something to one of our electrician clients.



I will evaluate both your technical experience and your spoken English/client communication ability.



Do not reveal another client's confidential information in your application or video.



If you are excellent at GoHighLevel, strong with automation and AI, communicate exceptionally well, think like an operator, and want to become a trusted long-term part of a growing company, I especially want to hear from you.

Audio: Clean audio, balanced sound levels, and optional subtle background music if needed.

Stayful Systems, our software company building tools for the short stay industry



This role sits across the two property businesses.



We are a small company. There is no layer of middle management, nobody looking over your shoulder, and nobody to pick up the pieces if something is left unfinished. That means real ownership, real influence, and real responsibility.



WHAT THIS ROLE IS



This role brings together two sides of the business that depend on each other.



Cleaner management. Our cleaners and cleaning companies are not scheduled by us. Once a cleaner is assigned to a property they plan their own rota and report their cleans through our systems. Your job is to manage them: build the relationship, monitor what they deliver, hold them to standard, and step in the moment quality slips.



Invoice verification and records. When a cleaner or contractor invoices us, you are the person who checks it against what was actually reported and completed before it is approved for payment. You are the last line of defence on every payment this company makes.



These two functions sit together for a reason. The person managing the cleaners is the person who knows whether the clean happened, who did it, and whether the invoice matches reality. Nobody is better placed to catch an error, a duplicate or an overcharge.



On top of this you will handle general company administration: staff rotas and records, payroll submission, and the day to day admin that keeps a remote business running.



You will report directly to Martyn, our Director.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

1. Cleaner management and performance



Our cleaners have autonomy over their own scheduling. You are not assigning individual cleans. You are managing the people and the standard.



Own the relationship with every cleaner and cleaning company on our books. They should know you, trust you, and come to you first when there is a problem

Monitor performance continuously using completion reports, photos, guest reviews and guest feedback

Give each cleaner performance feedback every week: what is working, what is not, and what needs to change

Hold cleaners to standard even when they would rather not engage. Cleaners are busy and regular check ins are easy for them to avoid, so you will need to be persuasive, persistent and firm when the situation calls for it

Raise problems directly, promptly and fairly, then follow up until they are genuinely resolved. Never let something slide because chasing it is awkward

Track recurring issues by cleaner and by property, and fix the underlying cause rather than patching the symptom every time

Keep a written record of every check in and every issue raised

2. Guest flexibility and cleaning policy compliance

Work with cleaners to accommodate early check ins and late checkouts wherever possible. These affect guest experience and revenue directly, and are worth the effort to arrange

Make sure our mid stay cleaning policy is followed: the cleans happen, on time, to standard

Make sure our deep cleaning policy is followed: cleans are booked in, completed on time, and verified rather than assumed

Verify completion through our systems and chase anything that has not been reported

3. Cleaner recruitment and onboarding

Find, vet and onboard new cleaners and cleaning companies, both to replace those who leave or underperform, and to set us up in new areas as we grow

Agree rates and terms, brief new cleaners fully on our standards, and set them up in our systems

Maintain a pipeline of potential cleaners so that losing one is never a crisis

4. Weekly reporting to management

Produce a weekly written report covering every cleaner: how they are performing, any issues and their status, and any opportunities you have spotted

Escalate significant problems as they happen rather than saving them for the report. Management should never be surprised by something you already knew

5. Invoice verification and payment control

Verify every incoming cleaning and contractor invoice before it is approved: correct supplier, correct property, correct date, correct rate, correct total

Cross check every invoiced clean against what was reported and completed in our systems. If a clean was not carried out, it does not get paid

Identify and challenge duplicates, double charges, rate changes that were never agreed, and invoices from suppliers we no longer work with

Query discrepancies directly with the supplier and resolve them, rather than passing them straight up the line

Log and process approved invoices through Apron and Xero

Chase missing invoices so costs land in the right month and nothing arrives as a surprise

6. Financial records

Keep income and expense records accurate, current and correctly categorised

Maintain the cashflow records in Google Sheets and keep the Stayful Finance Dashboard up to date

Flag discrepancies between the cashflow records, the invoices and the accounts as soon as you spot them

Send Martyn a short written weekly summary: what has been processed, what has been flagged, what is outstanding

7. Rotas, payroll and company admin

Keep staff rotas accurate and up to date, and arrange shift cover in advance rather than in a scramble

Maintain team records: hours logged, leave, onboarding documents, contact details

Prepare and submit payroll on time and correctly, checking hours and rates before submission rather than after

Handle general company administration: document management, supplier records, filing and renewals

Keep our processes and SOPs current, and write new ones where there is a gap

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Three qualities matter more than anything else in this role.



Attention to detail. You check things properly. You do not tick a box because a message was sent, and you do not approve an invoice because it looks roughly right. You compare it against what actually happened, and if the two do not match, you find out why.



Problem solving. When something is wrong, you take responsibility for putting it right. You use your initiative and work the problem through. Asking for help when you are genuinely stuck is fine and encouraged. Handing every difficulty straight to someone else to solve is not.



The confidence to hold people to account. You are comfortable being the person who chases. Our cleaners are busy and independent, and would generally rather get on with the job than take a weekly call. You will need to be persuasive and firm when firmness is what the situation needs, while keeping the relationship a good one. Both halves matter. Someone who cannot be direct will let standards drift, and someone who is only direct will lose us good cleaners.



What will not work here is leaving things unchecked or unanswered, or quietly hoping a problem goes unnoticed. We would far rather hear about a mistake immediately than find it three months later in the accounts. Raising a problem you spotted is never held against you. Hiding one is.



Essential

Demonstrable attention to detail in work where errors have a real cost, with specific examples you can talk us through

Experience verifying, checking or reconciling invoices, timesheets, payments or similar records

Experience managing contractors, suppliers or field staff you did not directly supervise, including chasing them and having the difficult conversation when work is not right

Strong written and spoken English. You will be speaking and writing to UK based cleaners and suppliers every day

Organised and reliable with deadlines and reporting, across many properties and moving parts at once

Comfortable with spreadsheets and digital tools, and quick to learn new systems

Able to work independently and manage your own workload without daily supervision

Available during UK business hours, 9am to 5pm GMT/BST. This is a firm requirement

Desirable

Experience in property management, short term rentals, hospitality or facilities

Experience managing cleaning, housekeeping or maintenance providers

Experience recruiting or sourcing contractors and negotiating rates

Xero experience, or bookkeeping and accounts payable experience

Familiarity with Apron or a similar invoice management tool

Experience running payroll or managing staff rotas and time records

Experience writing or improving SOPs and processes

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



The person who does well here will bring ideas to the table, not just complete tasks. If you can see a better way to monitor cleaner quality, a tighter way to check invoices, or a report that would give us visibility we currently lack, propose it and build it.



We are actively bringing AI into how our team works so that a small team can do more, to a higher standard, in less time. We want someone curious about this and willing to use these tools to work smarter, not someone nervous of them. If you already use AI tools in your work, tell us how.



Beyond the work itself, we want someone who is easy to work with and a pleasure to have on the team. We are a small group working remotely across time zones, so being straightforward, communicative and good natured matters here.



This is a full time role from day one. The rate starts at $5 per hour for the three month trial, and we expect to review it to $6 per hour for the right person once that is complete. We are a growing group of companies, and people who show initiative here get the first opportunity when new work comes up.



THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF

You are not available during UK business hours. This is a firm requirement with no flexibility

You are looking for part time work, or you have other commitments that would prevent you giving this role a full working week

You find it uncomfortable to chase people, push back on them, or have a direct conversation about work that is not good enough

You need constant direction, or you escalate every problem rather than attempting to solve it first

You would rather leave something ambiguous than ask the question that resolves it

You want a narrow, single task role. This one covers cleaner management, finance checking and general admin

Being accountable for the accuracy of payments feels like too much pressure

TOOLS YOU WILL USE

Uplisting. Property management system: bookings, calendars and cleaning records

WhatsApp. Day to day communication with cleaners and contractors

Xero. Accounting platform across both entities

Apron. Invoice management and approvals, integrated with Xero

Google Sheets. Cleaner records, cashflow records and supporting documentation

Stayful Finance Dashboard. Our internal platform for cash position and financial data

Connecteam. Rotas, time tracking and team records. You will log your own hours here and submit a matching invoice each Friday

Asana. Task and project tracking. Your work should be visible here without being asked for

Slack. Day to day communication with Martyn and the team

Google Meet. Weekly check in with Martyn

Claude (AI). We use AI across the business to work faster and more accurately. You will be trained and supported in using it

HOW TO APPLY



Applications are only accepted through our application form. Please do not send a message through OnlineJobs.ph. Applications sent that way will not be considered.



You must include the reference STAY-CFC in your application. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Apply here: 



In your application, please tell us about:



A time you spotted an error that others had missed, and what you did about it

A time you had to push a contractor or supplier to improve their work, and how you handled it

A problem you solved on your own initiative rather than escalating



Generic applications will not be considered.

title: Shopify Copywriters for Ongoing Projects (Immediate Start!)
description:
We are looking for multiple people to join our team working on ongoing Shopify projects. This role combines website copy with the back-end setup of Shopify stores.



Our developers build the store design. Your job starts once the design is finished, and takes the store from there to launch-ready.



On the copy side, this varies by project. On some stores you will be writing the on-theme copy from scratch to the client brief. On others our developers will have written a first pass, and your job is to review it, fix it and bring it up to standard. Either way, the finished copy on the theme is your responsibility. This is website and theme copy, not product description work.



The other part of the role is the store setup itself: settings, apps, pages, markets and shipping. This is checklist-driven work. We have recorded step-by-step video training covering every part of the process, so you will know exactly what to do and how we want it done. What we need is someone who follows those steps precisely, every single time, without needing to be chased or corrected.



What you will be doing:



* Writing on-theme website copy to the client brief, or reviewing and fixing copy already drafted by our developers

* Configuring Shopify store settings to our standard checklist

* Installing and setting up apps as specified per store

* Creating and uploading policy pages and other store pages

* Setting up markets, shipping zones and rates



What we need from you:



* Excellent written English — able to write clean, natural website copy that matches a brand's voice

* A sharp eye for detail — you should be able to spot a typo, a wrong product name, or a sentence that does not make sense

* Practical hands-on experience inside Shopify admin, not just theory

* The ability to follow written and video instructions exactly

* Willingness to ask before guessing. If something is missing from the brief, we want you to ask. If it is covered in the training videos, we expect you to find it there

* Reliable communication and availability for ongoing work



The details:



* Paid per completed store

* Full video training provided before you start

* Ongoing volume — we build stores continuously and want people who stay long term

* Paid trial store as the first step, so you get paid for the trial regardless of the outcome



How to apply:



Include the phrase "I listen Dylan" in your message so we know you have read this listing.



Tell us about your experience with Shopify - how long you have worked with it, and what you have handled across both the back end and the front end, outside of development itself. Settings, apps, pages, markets, shipping, theme content, copy. We want to know what you have actually done, not just that you are familiar with the platform.

title: We're Hiring: SEO Specialist (Philippines-Based)
description:
Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and passionate about SEO? Marketing Done Right (MDR) is looking for an SEO Specialist to join our Philippines-based team. If you’re ready to grow your skills in a supportive environment and play a key role in helping businesses succeed online, this opportunity is for you.





About Us

I’m Dustin, founder of Marketing Done Right, a Cleveland-based digital marketing agency that delivers top-tier Local SEO and National SEO solutions. At MDR, we value collaboration, growth, and making a measurable impact for our clients. Our team is close-knit and supportive, and we’re excited to welcome motivated individuals who want to grow with us.





Why Join Us?

Supportive Team Culture – Work in a collaborative pod structure with SEO Strategists, Specialists, and Supports.

Career Growth – Opportunity to advance into senior SEO or strategist-level roles as you develop your skills.

Diverse Projects – Gain experience across different industries, from local businesses to national brands.

Long-Term Stability – We’re looking for someone committed to growing with MDR for the long run.

Performance-Based Rewards – Salary increases and growth opportunities are available for strong performance.





Role Overview



The SEO Specialist works under the guidance of an SEO Strategist, helping turn strategies into actionable steps. You’ll play a key role in implementing SEO recommendations, gathering and organizing data, performing on-page optimizations, and coordinating with SEO Supports and other internal teams. This role ensures campaigns run smoothly, deadlines are met, and results are achieved.





Responsibilities



- Assist the SEO Strategist in implementing SEO strategies and recommendations.

- Suggest actionable improvements such as updated page titles, headers, or internal links.

- Perform on-page optimizations, including metadata updates, internal linking, and content formatting.

- Export, clean, and organize data from SEO tools for use in reporting and analysis.

- Assign certain tasks to SEO Supports and oversee their completion.

- Track timelines, deliverables, and workflows to help keep campaigns on schedule.

- Conduct quality checks on SEO tasks to ensure accuracy and alignment with expectations.

- Collaborate with internal teams (content, design, development, PPC) to support campaign execution.

- Maintain documentation of SEO changes, updates, and completed tasks.

- Stay updated on SEO trends, best practices, and algorithm changes.





Results (Expected Accomplishments)



- Tasks identified and delegated by the SEO Strategist are implemented correctly and delivered on time.

- Data exports are accurate, well-organized, and readily available for SEO Strategist analysis and reporting.

- On-page optimizations contribute to measurable improvements in search rankings, organic traffic, and user experience.

- Tasks assigned to SEO Supports are clearly delegated, tracked, and completed with minimal errors.

- Campaign workflows run smoothly, minimizing delays and ensuring deliverables are completed as scheduled.

- Quality assurance checks consistently catch issues before they affect project performance or reports.

- Documentation of implementations provides transparency and supports effective client and internal reporting.

- SEO campaigns show steady progress through accurate, timely, and data-driven implementation.

- The pod structure functions efficiently, with the SEO Specialist effectively supporting the SEO Strategist and guiding SEO Supports.





Requirements



- 1–2 years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in an agency or team setting.

- Strong understanding of on-page, off-page, and local SEO.

- Familiarity with tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Screaming Frog.

- Experience with CMS platforms like WordPress, Squarespace, or Shopify.

- Ability to organize and analyze exported SEO data.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to follow directions while also working independently.

- Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams (content, design, development, PPC).

- Ability to delegate and oversee tasks completed by SEO Supports.

- Strong organizational and time management skills.

- Problem-solving mindset, able to adapt quickly to urgent or shifting priorities.





How to Apply

- Experience working closely with cross-functional teams (such as content, design, development, PPC, and virtual assistants) to ensure deliverables align with SEO strategies and client goals.

- Ability to think critically, stay calm under pressure, and find solutions in urgent or challenging situations.

- Comfortable giving direction, feedback, and guidance to tea
mbers to keep projects on track.

- Detail-oriented, organized, and able to keep timelines and deliverables moving smoothly.

- Familiarity with the latest SEO trends, algorithm updates, and digital marketing practices.

title: Medical Virtual Assistant – Best Practice Premier/Splose/Halaxy Tool Experience Needed
description:
We are looking for experienced Medical Virtual Assistants to support Australian medical clinics with a range of reception, patient administration, appointment management, billing, and general healthcare administrative tasks.



This role is ideal for someone who is confident using Best Practice Premier/Splose/Halaxy and is comfortable working in a busy, phone-heavy medical environment. Depending on the client and clinic's needs, you may support general practitioners, allied health professionals, nurses, and reception teams.



A significant part of the role may involve handling a high volume of inbound and outbound patient calls, so candidates must be confident, professional, and comfortable communicating with patients, including elderly patients.



Key Responsibilities

Patient Reception & Communication

Answer and manage a high volume of incoming and outgoing patient calls.

Assist patients with general enquiries.

Book, confirm, cancel, and reschedule appointments.

Manage appointment reminders, confirmations, recalls, and waitlists.

Take accurate messages and relay them to doctors, nurses, and other clinic staff.

Communicate with patients via phone,
, SMS, and other communication platforms.

Provide professional, patient, and empathetic support, particularly when communicating with elderly patients.



Appointment & Practice Management

Manage doctor and allied health provider calendars and appointment availability.

Help fill appointment gaps and maintain full appointment schedules.

Manage opportunistic bookings and follow up with patients as required.

Coordinate appointments for services such as GP consultations, Physiotherapy, Podiatry, Dietetics, Psychology, nursing, and other allied health services.

Support telehealth appointment administration where required.

Please do not send a generic application.

The systems side

- Working in our CRM — pipelines, opportunities, forms, custom fields

- Supporting workflows and automations,
 and SMS campaigns

- Making sure enquiries are captured properly and followed through

- Blog uploads and page updates on our website, with half an eye on how they are structured for search

- Tracking what actually produces enquiries, not just impressions



We use GoHighLevel. Hands-on GHL experience is a real advantage and we want to hear about it in detail. Comparable CRM experience — HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Keap, Zoho — plus a genuine ability to learn systems works too. Over time we want to bring more of our paid advertising in-house, so if you understand how ads, search and analytics fit together, that is where this role has the most room to grow



How we think about AI

We use AI here every day and we expect you to. Being good with it is a skill we value.



What we are hiring is your judgement — the pacing of a cut, the hook in the first two seconds, the reason one shot follows another, the voice in a caption. Our homes are custom and our content should feel the same way: recognisably ours.



If you can point at a real piece of your own work and tell us exactly where the model helped and where you took over, you are the sort of person we want to talk to.



Who this suits

You will not be expected to work it all out alone. You will have plenty of support while you learn our business, our brand and the way we work, and we expect questions during onboarding — we collaborate closely as a team.



As you settle in we will expect you to take increasing ownership of your work. The people who do well with us bring solutions rather than questions, flag issues early rather than on the deadline, take feedback well and go around again to hit the standard, and genuinely care about what they put their name to. Every so often they send us something nobody asked for that turns out to be exactly what we needed.



If you want to be told exactly what to do each morning, this will frustrate you. If you have been looking for somewhere that gives you real ownership and rewards it, this is that.



What you need

- Around three years of hands-on content creation experience — where video, design and social content have been a meaningful part of your actual role. If you have less but a portfolio that speaks for itself, apply anyway

- Strong short-form vertical video editing — building an edit from raw, unsorted footage rather than working from a template

- Confidence in CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects or DaVinci Resolve — whichever is genuinely yours, and tell us which

- Strong Canva skills and the discipline to hold an existing brand kit

- Real hands-on confidence inside a CRM, ideally GoHighLevel

- Fluency with AI tools, and the judgement to keep the creative decisions your own

- Excellent written and spoken English

- The ability to work two days a week without being chased, and to say early when

something will not be ready



Helpful, not essential: construction, architecture or property experience · Google Ads or Meta Ads · SEO fundamentals and Google Analytics · WordPress · Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign · LinkedIn content



How to apply

One honest note first. We know some people will paste this ad into an AI tool and send back whatever comes out. We are not against you using AI to help you write — we use it every day ourselves. But we can tell the difference between an application written with help and one where nobody was really there, and we only want to hear from people who actually want this particular job at this particular company.



Two of the things below cannot be produced by a tool. They are the two we read first.

1. Your resume

2. A link to your portfolio. We want to see short-form video you have edited yourself, not only static work

3. One or two sentences on our Instagram — 
 — go and look at it, then tell us one thing you would change and one thing you would keep. Be honest; we would genuinely rather hear a real criticism than a compliment

4. A few lines in your own words on why this role suits you. This one is for someone who wants to grow inside a tight-knit team and wants their work rewarded



Put the word PROCESS at the top so we know you read to the bottom.

title: CapCut only editor for Instagram Reels - Soft/warm AI educational video
description:
Hi I'm Cindy! I run an AI education brand with a 200k+ audience across two Instagram accounts. My reels teach people how to actually use Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code and AI builds. I'm hiring editors to take a finished cut and turn it into the finished video. My style is a cute + scrapbook style and I explain AI concepts and builds.



Role description



You get the cut with the bad takes and pauses already removed. I also provide my editors an Editing Guide which includes where to grab screenshots/ screen recordings, so you're never working on a blank page. You'll also have the support of my Senior Editors, who can guide you to align closely with my style. 



Here's the role:

- Understand the concept being taught or refer to the Editing Guide for more inspiration.

- Source and build the screen recordings. If I'm talking about a tool, the viewer needs to see it in action. You capture or assemble those and align them to the exact words they belong to.

- Sound design. Every visual reveal gets a sound cue: a pop, a click, a page turn, a soft ding. There is no music. My voice plus sound effects carry the whole video.

- Good pacing. 



The short version: I explain the idea out loud, and you build everything the viewer needs to see to understand it.



Hard requirements



- CapCut proficiency. 

- Comfortable capturing and editing screen recordings

- You use AI tools yourself. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be generating images and diagrams with them already.

- Strong eye for short-form pacing on Instagram

- Warm, cute, arts-and-crafts taste. Never corporate, never tech-bro.

- Fluent English, good enough to follow a technical explanation and know what it means

- Turnaround of 1 to 2 days per reel



Nice to have



- You already use Claude or ChatGPT day to day

- Experience editing for AI, tech or educational creators

- Familiar with current Instagram hook formats and retention edits



Hard nos



Hard whip-pans, glitch or VHS effects, trending transition packs, generic tech stock footage, corporate imagery, harsh blues and neon.



The editing support you get



- Editing Guide so you know which assets to grab or record.

- CapCut Pro 

- Reference videos for every video you edit so you have a place to grab inspiration

- The cut of each reel, already trimmed

- Clear, fast feedback so you can lock the style within a few reels

- Support from our Senior Editors



PAY



- USD $35 per reel, paid through Upwork as a milestone per reel.

- Rate increases as you align closer to my style. 

- Steady, consistent volume. We publish constantly and there is always more work.



How to apply



Answer the screening questions, and attach 2 to 3 short-form samples you personally edited (CapCut preferred). Start your first answer with the words "capcut teams" so I know you read the whole post.

title: Cold Caller and Database Creator
description:
PART-TIME BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT & LEAD GENERATION COORDINATOR



Remote – Philippines | 20 Hours Per Week | USD $5.50 Per Hour + Bonuses



Are you confident on the phone, great at talking to people and good at opening doors?



We are a growing Australian business group operating across several industries, with a strong presence in events, entertainment, activations, markets, partnerships and new business ventures.



We are looking for a confident and personable Business Development & Lead Generation Coordinator to help us connect with potential clients, introduce our businesses and create new opportunities.



This is not aggressive telemarketing and we don't want someone reading a robotic script.



Your job is to make genuine contact with prospective clients, introduce who we are, find the right decision-maker, start a conversation and create an opportunity for our Australian team to take forward.



HOURS & PAY



20 hours per week – part-time and remote.



Starting rate: USD $5.50 per hour



This equates to approximately USD $475–$500 per month base, depending on hours worked.



There is also an opportunity to earn performance bonuses for generating quality opportunities and new business.



Our proposed bonus structure includes:



USD $5 bonus for a genuinely qualified meeting booked

Additional USD $10–$20 bonus where a lead converts into a new client, depending on the value of the opportunity

Salary review after 3 months based on performance, reliability, initiative and results



For someone who consistently performs well, there will be opportunity for both rate increases and additional hours as the role develops.



A significant portion of your working hours will need to overlap with Australian business hours as you will be speaking directly with Australian businesses and organisations.



THE ROLE



You will work across several different brands and campaigns, so the role is varied and there is always something new to work on.



One day you might be contacting shopping centres about entertainment and activations.



Another day you may be speaking with councils, venues, businesses, sponsors, clubs or corporate organisations about one of our other services or projects.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



Your role will include:



Researching prospective clients and organisations

Finding the correct decision-makers and contact details

Making outbound calls to Australian businesses

Introducing our company and services in a friendly, professional way

Starting conversations with prospective clients

Identifying businesses that may have a genuine need for our services

Asking the right questions to understand upcoming opportunities

Obtaining the correct
 address for proposals and information

Sending company information, capability documents and introductory
s

Following up information that has already been sent

Reconnecting with previous clients and contacts

Following up warm leads and enquiries

Booking calls or meetings for our Australian management team where appropriate

Keeping clear notes on every conversation

Building and maintaining prospect databases

Researching new industries and potential customer groups

Building targeted
 databases for future marketing campaigns

Updating CRM records and contact information

Identifying upcoming events, campaigns, developments and opportunities that may generate business

Helping create prospect lists for new services and brands

Keeping track of follow-ups so opportunities are not forgotten

Reporting on calls, contacts, leads and opportunities generated

THIS IS ABOUT OPENING DOORS



We are not expecting you to close large contracts on the first telephone call.



Your goal is to get us past:



"Who do I need to speak to?"



and move us towards:



"Yes, please send me some information."



or even better:



"That sounds interesting. Let's organise a meeting."



You will be the person who creates the beginning of that relationship.



WE WANT SOMEONE WHO IS PROACTIVE



We don't want to hand you 100 phone numbers and simply ask you to call them.



We want someone who can also think:



"Who else could buy this?"



"What other companies should we approach?"



"Who is the right person inside this organisation?"



"They aren't interested now, but when should I contact them again?"



"I noticed this company has an event coming up — should we approach them?"



We want someone who enjoys finding opportunities and building a pipeline.



YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU:

Speak excellent, confident English

Are comfortable talking to Australian businesses

Have a friendly and natural telephone manner

Are persuasive without being pushy

Don't get discouraged by hearing "no"

Can build rapport quickly

Are organised and reliable

Have excellent attention to detail

Can research businesses independently

Are confident using Google, LinkedIn and online directories

Can maintain databases accurately

Write professional
s

Follow up without needing to be constantly reminded

Can manage several different campaigns at once

Are comfortable working independently

Take initiative and look for opportunities



Previous experience in business development, appointment setting, outbound calling, lead generation, sales, virtual assistance or CRM/database management would be highly regarded.



Experience speaking with Australian, UK or US customers would also be an advantage.



THIS IS NOT A CALL-CENTRE ROLE



We care much more about quality conversations than simply hitting a ridiculous number of calls per hour.



We want our prospective clients to have a positive first impression of our businesses.



You should sound like part of our team — not like somebody reading from a script in a call centre.



There will be targets and accountability, but we will be looking at outcomes including:



Decision-makers identified

Genuine conversations

Information packs requested

Qualified leads generated

Follow-ups created

Meetings generated

Database growth

New opportunities uncovered

New clients generated

OPPORTUNITY TO GROW



Our businesses continue to expand and new projects are regularly being launched.



For the right person, there is significant opportunity to grow with us and become an important part of our business development and sales team, with the potential for additional hours, increased pay and greater responsibility in the future.



TO APPLY



Please send us:



A short introduction about yourself

Details of your previous outbound calling or business development experience

Any experience calling Australian businesses

The types of clients or industries you have previously contacted

CRM/database systems you have used

Your availability and the hours you can work

Confirmation that you are comfortable with the starting rate of USD $5.50 per hour + performance bonuses

A short voice recording introducing yourself as though you were calling a prospective Australian client



And finally, tell us:



If we gave you a new service tomorrow and asked you to find 100 Australian businesses that might buy it, how would you approach the task?



We are looking for someone confident, resourceful and proactive who can become a genuine part of our growing team.



Please do not apply without including the requested voice recording.

title: Youtube Faceless Video Editor
description:
# Full-Time Video Editor — Faceless YouTube Channel (News/Story Content)



**Type:** Faceless YouTube channel, long-form story-driven news content

**Commitment:** Full-time, 6 days/week, 8 hours/day

**Schedule:** Fast-paced, daily deadlines — each video is scripted, edited, and approved same-day

**Resources provided:** Full VO script and reference video for every video



---



## About the Role



We run a fast-growing faceless YouTube channel producing long-form, story-driven videos on trending news. Every video starts from a professional voiceover script — your job is to bring it to life visually.



We're looking for a full-time video editor who can independently source footage, cut a polished long-form edit, and design a high-CTR thumbnail, consistently, every single day. This is a long-term role with stable pay and real growth potential as the channel scales.



**How the day works:** you'll receive a VO script and reference video, then edit, finalize, and submit for approval. The video is "done" once it's approved and no further revisions are needed. If you finish early and get approval ahead of schedule, your day can end early. If approval takes longer, you keep working until the video is finalized and accepted.



---



## What You'll Do



- **Edit 1 long-form video daily** (25–35 minutes), tightly synced to the provided VO script, with a polished, broadcast-quality finish.

- **Source and organize B-roll at volume** — dozens to hundreds of clips per video, pulled from stock libraries, YouTube archives, news footage, public event clips, interviews, archival material, paparazzi footage, and royalty-free assets. Every clip must match exactly what's being said in that moment — no generic filler, no "close enough" stock footage.

- **Match visuals precisely to narration.** If the script mentions a specific person, event, or moment, the footage on screen needs to reflect that specific moment — viewers should feel the video was built for the story, not assembled from whatever was on hand.

- **Keep retention high** across the full runtime with varied visuals: close-ups, reaction clips, text overlays, and relevant cutaways.

- **Add professional finishing touches** — subtitles/captions, smooth transitions, background music, and cinematic pacing built for retention.

- **Design 1 CTR-focused thumbnail daily** — bold, emotionally charged, YouTube-native style with strong visual hierarchy.

- **Maintain an organized shared asset library** and hit daily deadlines without needing follow-up.



---



## What You Need



- Proven proficiency in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or DaVinci Resolve

- Strong thumbnail design skills in Photoshop or Canva

- Strong research skills — the patience to find the *exact* clip for a 25–35 minute script, not just something close

- High attention to detail — visuals need to match narration precisely (e.g., if the script says "the garden party in 2018," the footage needs to be from that specific event, not a generic stand-in)

- Experience sourcing B-roll from stock libraries, YouTube archives, and public media

- A reliable workstation and fast internet capable of handling long-form projects

- Strong English comprehension (all scripts and voiceovers are in English)

- A sharp sense of storytelling, pacing, and retention for news-style content

- Good judgment on footage — knowing what adds emotional weight versus what's just noise

- Full-time availability: 6 days/week, 8 hours/day, delivering 1 complete video + 1 thumbnail daily, with prompt responses during working hours



---



## Bonus Points



- Experience editing news, current events, or royal/celebrity content

- Familiarity with royalty-free platforms (Storyblocks, Pexels, Artgrid, etc.) and basic audio mixing

- Solid grasp of YouTube CTR and retention best practices (hooks, pacing, visual variety)

- Experience on long-form content where retention past the 50% mark is a real priority



---



## How to Apply



Message me directly here, or
 with the subject line: **YouTube Editor Application – [Your Name]**



Please include:

1. An example of a long-form video you've edited (link preferred)

2. A YouTube-style thumbnail you've designed

3. Your editing/design tools (software + hardware specs)

4. Your availability — earliest start date and preferred 8-hour working schedule

title: Experienced E-Commerce Facebook Media Buyer & Creative Editor
description:
# Experienced E-Commerce
 Media Buyer & Creative Editor



**Remote Full-Time Position | $6/hour + Bonuses | Long-Term**



We are growing our e-commerce advertising team and are looking for someone who already has strong hands-on experience with **Meta Ads and e-commerce ad creatives.**



The ideal candidate can take a product and handle the advertising process from start to finish:



**Research → Create Ads → Launch Campaigns → Analyze Results → Improve Performance**



You must be comfortable both inside **Meta Ads Manager** and inside video editing software.



This is an important requirement.



We do not want a Media Buyer who depends on another person for every creative, and we do not want a video editor who does not understand advertising performance.



## Your Role



Your main responsibility will be to help us test and scale e-commerce products using
 and Instagram Ads.



A large part of your daily work will involve creating new advertising creatives.



You will research:



* Competitor advertisements

* Product demonstrations

* UGC content

* Customer reviews

* Product benefits

* Hooks

* Creative angles

* Existing winning advertisements



You will then turn this material into new e-commerce ads.



This includes:



* Video editing

* Strong opening hooks

* Text overlays

* Subtitles

* Voiceovers

* Product benefits

* Different calls to action

* Different creative angles

* Multiple variations of each ad



You should be able to create ads quickly while still understanding the purpose behind each creative.



Every creative should be designed to improve performance.



## Media Buying



You will personally launch and manage
 and Instagram campaigns.



Your daily work may include:



* Launching new product tests

* Launching new creatives

* Monitoring campaign performance

* Comparing creatives

* Identifying winning ads

* Stopping poor performers

* Optimizing campaigns

* Scaling successful campaigns

* Testing new angles

* Testing new offers

* Managing multiple products and stores



You should be able to work independently without needing instructions for every small campaign decision.



## Understanding KPIs



We place a lot of importance on KPI knowledge.



You must understand:



* CPA

* ROAS

* CTR

* CPC

* CPM

* Conversion Rate

* AOV

* Frequency

* Break-Even CPA

* Break-Even ROAS



More importantly, you should understand **what these numbers mean together.**



You should be able to recognize situations such as:



A low CTR may indicate a weak creative or hook.



A good CTR with poor sales may indicate a problem with the offer, product page, or conversion rate.



A high CPM does not automatically mean an ad is bad if the CPA and profitability are still strong.



A winning creative should lead to new variations, hooks, and angles being tested.



We are looking for someone who thinks this way naturally.



## Creative Skills



You should be comfortable creating ads yourself using tools such as:



* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere Pro

* Canva

* After Effects

* Other similar editing software



You should have a good understanding of **direct-response e-commerce advertising**, not only traditional video editing.



Your job is not to make cinematic videos.



Your job is to make videos that **sell products.**



## Additional Tasks



A smaller part of the role may involve adjusting landing pages or product pages.



We will usually provide existing templates or examples.



You may occasionally:



* Change images and videos

* Update product text

* Change prices or offers

* Check links and buttons

* Make simple page adjustments

* Check mobile and desktop layouts



Advanced web development is not required.



Basic Shopify, Wix, or similar experience is enough.



## Who We Are Looking For



You should already have:



* E-commerce
 Ads experience

* Physical product advertising experience

* Meta Ads Manager experience

* Creative testing experience

* Video editing experience

* Strong KPI knowledge

* Experience analyzing campaign performance

* Experience optimizing campaigns

* Experience scaling profitable campaigns

* Strong competitor research skills

* Good English communication

* Good organization and reliability



Experience with **lead generation only is not enough for this position.**



We specifically want someone who has worked with **e-commerce sales campaigns and understands purchase-focused advertising.**



## Compensation & Growth



* **Starting rate: $6 USD/hour**

* Weekly payments

* Performance bonuses

* Additional commissions possible

* Salary increases based on performance

* Fully remote

* Long-term position



We want someone who can stay with the team long-term.



Strong performers can eventually take on more responsibility, help train junior staff, and move into a Team Lead position.



We value people who can combine:



**Good Creatives + Good Media Buying + Good KPI Decisions**



If you understand all three, this role should be a strong fit.

title: GOOGLE ADS SPECIALIST – HIGH-INTENT, SAME-DAY PLUMBING LEADS
description:
GOOGLE ADS SPECIALIST – HIGH-INTENT, SAME-DAY PLUMBING LEADS



We are Genies Plumbing, a rapidly growing same-day residential plumbing company based on the Gold Coast, Australia, with plans to expand into Brisbane.



We need an experienced Google Ads specialist who can consistently generate high-quality phone calls from customers who need a plumber today.



This is not a basic VA, social-media or reporting role. I want somebody genuinely skilled at Google Ads for local service businesses.



THE MAIN OBJECTIVE



Generate profitable same-day plumbing enquiries for:



* Blocked drains

* CCTV drain inspections and jetting

* Pipe relining

* Leak detection

* Electric hot-water systems

* Emergency plumbing

* General plumbing maintenance



We want customers ready to book—not DIY searches, job seekers, sales representatives, suppliers or people shopping for plumbing products.



COMPLETE TRACKING IS ESSENTIAL



I want the entire customer journey tracked:



Google search → ad impression → ad click → landing page → phone call or form → genuine enquiry → booked job → completed job → revenue and gross profit.



I want reporting to clearly show:



* Impressions

* Clicks

* Click-through rate

* Cost per click

* Calls generated

* Cost per call

* Answered and missed calls

* Call duration

* Genuine versus junk calls

* Forms submitted

* Cost per genuine enquiry

* Booking rate

* Booked jobs

* Cost per booked job

* Completed jobs

* Revenue attributed to Google Ads

* Return on advertising spend

* Gross profit generated

* Results by campaign, service, location, keyword, search term, advertisement, landing page, device, day and time



A phone-number click is not automatically a lead. A call is not automatically a genuine enquiry, and an enquiry is not automatically a booked or profitable job.



I already use ServiceM8, Excel and internal reporting to track customers, jobs and revenue. I can provide the job outcomes. You must know how to connect and use this information to improve Google Ads, including offline conversion tracking where appropriate.



WHAT YOU WILL MANAGE



* Google Search campaigns

* Campaign and ad-group structure

* Keyword and search-intent strategy

* Exact and phrase-match selection

* Daily budget allocation

* Search-term reviews and negative keywords

* Bidding strategy

* Location, schedule and device targeting

* Advertisement and asset testing

* Service-specific landing-page direction

* Conversion and attribution quality

* Gold Coast campaign performance

    – Future Brisbane expansion

* Weekly optimisation and commercial reporting



We care about qualified calls, booked jobs, completed revenue and gross profit—not vanity figures.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS



* Approximately AUD $800,000–$1 million turnover

* Multiple technicians and vehicles

* More than 220 five-star Google reviews

* Same-day residential service

* Gold Coast base

* Brisbane expansion planned

* High-value opportunities in relining, drains, leak detection and hot water



ABOUT ME



I am the owner and will work directly with you.



I am technically capable and can build landing pages, implement tracking and make website changes quickly. I need someone who is better than me at paid-search strategy, account structure and optimisation.



All advertising accounts, campaigns, analytics, tracking and data will remain owned by Genies Plumbing.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



* Strong practical Google Ads Search experience

* Local-service or home-service lead generation

* High-intent phone-call campaigns

* Google Tag Manager and GA4

* Call tracking and dynamic number insertion

* GCLID capture and offline conversion tracking

* Search-term and negative-keyword management

* Location targeting for service-area businesses

* Landing-page conversion strategy

* Using booked-job and revenue feedback to optimise advertising

* Clear written English and honest communication



Experience with plumbing, electrical, HVAC, roofing or urgent home services is strongly preferred.



HOW TO APPLY



Begin your application with “SAME-DAY LEADS.”



Then answer:



1. Describe one local-service Google Ads account you personally managed. Include the industry, location, monthly spend, qualified calls and cost per qualified lead.

2. Explain how you would track this journey:



Google click → phone call → genuine enquiry → ServiceM8 booking → completed job → revenue.



3. How would you calculate cost per call, cost per genuine enquiry and cost per booked job?

4. How would you structure campaigns for drains, emergency plumbing, leak detection, hot water, relining and general plumbing?

5. How frequently would you review search terms?

6. What would you do if a keyword generated cheap calls but none became booked jobs?

7. What bidding strategy would you initially use if reliable booked-job data wasn’t available?

8. Send evidence from an account you personally managed. Remove confidential client information.

9. Are you an individual or an agency? Who will personally work inside our account?

10. State your hourly or monthly rate and availability during Australian hours.



PAID TEST



Shortlisted applicants will receive exported Google Ads data and complete a paid three-hour assessment.



You will identify:



* The most important wasted expenditure

* The first three changes you would make

* The recommended campaign structure

* The tracking and attribution structure

* Which services should receive the initial budget

* A realistic 30/60/90-day plan

* What cannot be concluded from the available data



This is a long-term opportunity. As the business, locations, team and advertising budget grow, the role can grow with them.

title: Shopify Product & E-commerce Manager — $4/Hour
description:
**PLEASE READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This position is **$4/hour**, but this is **NOT a simple data-entry or product-uploading job.**



We are looking for someone who is genuinely interested in this position and wants to take ownership of the work.



If you are only applying because you are looking for any available VA job, **please do not apply.**



If you are genuinely interested, please understand that our hiring process will be **serious and thorough**.



We will interview candidates extensively and ask detailed questions about Shopify, e-commerce, AI, product research, pricing, competitors, and how you think.



**We will only hire someone after a proper interview and evaluation.**



We are looking for someone who wants to stay with us long-term and potentially take on significantly more responsibility as they prove themselves.



### IMPORTANT — APPLICATION



We also ask that you **do not apply for a higher amount than the $4/hour rate listed for this position.**



If you apply for a higher rate, we will take that as an indication that you may not be genuinely interested in the position as advertised.



If you are comfortable starting at **$4/hour** and believe you can prove your value through your work, we are happy to discuss increases in the future based on performance and responsibility.



---



# About the Position



We are looking for a **Shopify Product & E-commerce Manager** to help manage and maintain our Shopify product catalog and feed.



This role involves much more than uploading products.



You will be responsible for looking at:



* Supplier quotations and costs

* Our product catalog

* Competitor products

* Competitor pricing

* Our own sales

* Product listings

* Product images

* Product titles and descriptions

* AI-generated product information

* Opportunities to improve conversion rates



You need to be someone who can **look at the data and think**, rather than simply follow instructions.



---



# Your Main Responsibilities



### 1. Shopify Product Management



* Manage and maintain Shopify products.

* Add and update products.

* Check product titles, descriptions, variants, pricing, images, and other information.

* Find and correct mistakes in product listings.

* Keep our product feed organized and accurate.

* Review products before they are published.



### 2. Supplier Pricing



You will regularly review supplier quotations and costs.



You will need to identify things such as:



* Supplier prices increasing or decreasing

* Products where our margins have changed

* Products that need their selling price updated

* Products where our pricing is no longer competitive



You should be comfortable working with spreadsheets and comparing large amounts of product data.



### 3. Competitor Research



A major part of the job will be researching competitors.



For products we sell, you may need to check:



* What competitors are charging

* How they present their products

* What product images they use

* How they write their titles

* How they structure their descriptions

* What offers they are using

* How our listing compares to theirs



You should be able to look at a competitor and identify:



**"What are they doing better than us, and what can we change?"**



### 4. Pricing Management



You will help us keep our prices competitive.



Pricing decisions may take into account:



* Supplier cost

* Competitor pricing

* Our margins

* Sales volume

* Product performance

* Market conditions



You will need to regularly monitor these things and bring potential pricing changes to our attention.



### 5. Sales Monitoring



You will keep an updated eye on our product sales.



You should be able to identify:



* Products that are selling well

* Products that aren't selling

* Products suddenly getting more sales

* Products where sales have dropped

* Products that may need a price change

* Products that may need listing or image improvements



We want someone who can look at sales data and **notice opportunities and problems.**



---



# AI & Claude — VERY IMPORTANT



**AI experience is a major requirement for this position.**



We use AI heavily in our e-commerce operations.



For example, we may use **Claude** to import a large number of products into our Shopify store and generate product information.



Your job will then be to review and manage that process.



You may need to:



* Fill in product information in Google Sheets.

* Review AI-generated product information.

* Correct mistakes made by AI.

* Improve product titles.

* Improve product descriptions.

* Check AI-generated information against supplier information.

* Identify incorrect assumptions made by AI.

* Make sure products are properly prepared before publishing.

* Help improve the AI workflow over time.



You should be comfortable working with AI-generated work and **know that AI is not always correct.**



We don't want someone who blindly accepts whatever Claude produces.



We want someone who can say:



**"Claude got this wrong. Here's what it should be."**



Even better, we want someone who can figure out:



**"Why did Claude make this mistake, and how can we change the workflow so it doesn't happen again?"**



---



# Product Images & Conversion Optimization



Another important part of the job is improving our product listings to get better conversions.



You will be expected to look at competitor listings and identify opportunities to improve ours.



This can include:



* Reviewing product images

* Comparing our images with competitors

* Finding better product images

* Recommending image changes

* Improving titles

* Improving descriptions

* Improving the overall presentation of products



The goal isn't simply:



**"The product has been uploaded."**



The goal is:



**"This is a good product listing that has a strong chance of converting."**



---



# What We Are Looking For



### Required:



* Good Shopify experience

* Strong Google Sheets skills

* Good attention to detail

* Good English

* Comfortable researching products online

* Comfortable researching competitors

* Comfortable working with pricing data

* Comfortable working with AI

* Experience with Claude is highly preferred

* Able to work independently

* Able to handle a large number of products

* Able to identify mistakes without needing everything explained



### Strongly Preferred:



* Dropshipping experience

* E-commerce experience

* Experience managing large Shopify catalogs

* Experience with product feeds

* Google Shopping experience

* Competitor research experience

* Product pricing experience

* AI automation experience

* Experience working with Claude

* Experience with bulk product imports



---



# The Type of Person We Want



We want someone who is **proactive.**



For example, if you notice:



> "The supplier increased the cost of this product."



You should notice it.



If you notice:



> "Our competitor is selling the same product for less."



You should notice it.



If you notice:



> "This product is selling well, but our images are much worse than the competitor."



You should notice it.



If you notice:



> "Claude made the same mistake across 50 products."



You should notice it and help fix the underlying problem.



We don't want someone who waits for instructions for every single task.



We want someone who can **think like an e-commerce operator.**



---



# Salary



**$4/hour**



This is a **full-time, long-term position**.



For the right person, there is room for increased pay and responsibility over time based on performance.



We care much more about finding the **right person** than finding the cheapest person.



---



# Hiring Process



Please understand that this will **not be an easy interview process.**



Because this position involves pricing, product management, AI, competitor research, and e-commerce decisions, we will interview candidates thoroughly.



We may ask you practical questions and give you scenarios to see how you think.



We are looking for someone who can actually perform the job, not someone who simply has "Shopify VA" written on their resume.



**If you are serious about this position, take your application seriously.**



---



# How To Apply



Start your application with:



**SHOPIFY + AI**



Then answer ALL of the following:



1. How many years of Shopify experience do you have?

2. How many Shopify stores have you worked on?

3. Approximately how many products have you managed?

4. Have you used Claude? If yes, explain exactly what you have used it for.

5. What other AI tools do you regularly use?

6. Have you worked with dropshipping?

7. Have you done competitor pricing research?

8. Have you worked with large Google Sheets/product feeds?

9. Give us one example of a mistake you found in AI-generated work and how you corrected it.

10. Give us one example of how you improved a product listing or helped increase conversions.

11. What do you think is more important when managing product pricing: competitor price, supplier cost, margin, or sales performance? Explain your answer.

12. What is your expected hourly rate? **Please note that the starting rate for this position is $4/hour.**



**Please do not send a generic application.**



Applications that do not follow the instructions above will be ignored.



We are specifically looking for someone who is genuinely interested in **Shopify, e-commerce, AI, product management, competitor research, and optimization**.



If that's you, we would like to hear from you.

Help us audit Google Ads accounts, set up campaigns, make changes on a regular basis, and manage Google Ads clients. Work directly with a UK-based Google Ads specialist.



Requirements:

3+ years Google Ads experience

Strong English (written & spoken)
