title: Video Editor
description:
What we do.



We're a DTC supplement brand spending six figures a month on Meta acquiring customers. Every dollar of that spend runs through video ads. The person editing those ads determines whether we scale or stall.



That's you.



What the job actually is.



You take scripts and turn them into ads that hold attention and drive purchases. That is the job. Not brand films. Not YouTube vlogs. Not social content. You edit direct-response video ads — AI creatives and VSLs — that run against cold traffic on Meta, and you do it at volume.



We don't shoot with UGC creators. We don't run live productions. Our entire creative pipeline is AI-built. AI-generated video, AI imagery, AI voiceover, motion graphics, screen recordings, stock footage — assembled into ads that sell. If you're still editing the traditional way and treating AI tools as a novelty, this isn't the right fit. AI is not a nice-to-have here. It is the production method. You need to be the person who already knows what Runway, Kling, Minimax, Pika, Hailuo, ElevenLabs, Midjourney, Flux, and similar tools can and can't do — and you're actively keeping up as the capabilities change every few weeks.



The editor who thrives here is the one who sees a script, immediately knows which AI tools produce the best output for each section, generates the raw materials fast, and assembles them into something that doesn't look like an AI demo reel — it looks like an ad that makes someone stop scrolling and buy.



On a given week you will cut 5–15 ad variations. Some are short-form hooks under 30 seconds. Some are full VSLs running 3–10 minutes. You'll work directly with the creative strategist who writes the scripts. Their words are the blueprint. Your edit is the execution — pacing, visual rhythm, text overlays, transitions, the moment-to-moment decisions that keep someone watching or let them leave.



Day to day:



Generate AI visuals and footage from scripts. Edit ads. Build hook variations — same script, different visual openings, different pacing, different first three seconds. Review performance data with the creative strategist to understand what's working and why. Re-cut winners into new variations to extend their life. Test different visual treatments on the same angle. Stay current on new AI tools and capabilities — what launched last week might change how we produce next week's ads. Repeat.



What you need to be good at:



AI-native production. You don't just know how to prompt an image generator — you know how to prompt it for the specific visual style that performs in direct-response ads. You can generate consistent characters across scenes. You can produce AI video that holds up at full resolution on a phone screen without the uncanny-valley artifacts that kill credibility. You understand the current limitations of each tool and you work around them instead of fighting them.



Pacing. You understand that a direct-response ad has a rhythm — it earns attention in the first second, holds it through the mechanism, and drives action at the close. You can feel when an edit drags, when a transition is a millisecond too slow, when a text overlay stays on screen long enough to read but not long enough to bore.



You're fluent in at least one professional editing tool — Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci, CapCut Pro, or equivalent. You know how to composite AI-generated assets cleanly, color grade for consistency across mixed sources, add motion graphics, and handle text animation. You're fast.



Experience with supplement, health, or DTC ad editing is a strong plus. If you've cut VSLs before, even better — you understand the specific rhythm of a long-form sales video where every visual beat serves a persuasion purpose, not an entertainment one.



Who this is for.



You live in AI tools. Not dabble — live. You've already produced real video content using AI generation and you're not waiting for someone to teach you the workflow. You follow the space closely enough that when a new model drops, you're testing it within days to see if it's better than what you're currently using.



You've edited video ads before — ideally for a brand spending real money on paid social. You understand that the first three seconds are life or death.



You're fast and you don't need hand-holding. When a script lands in your inbox, you can generate the assets and turn around a first cut the same day.



You're hungry. You want to get better at this specific craft — cutting AI-produced ads that make money — and you want the reps to prove it.



Who this is not for.



If you think AI creative is a gimmick or a shortcut for people who can't shoot real video, this isn't the role. This is our production method and we take it seriously.



If your portfolio is wedding videos and short films, this isn't the role. If your instinct is to make things cinematic rather than converting, this isn't the role. Beautiful editing that doesn't hold a cold audience past three seconds is beautiful editing that loses money.



If you need detailed shot-by-shot storyboards for every ad before you start cutting, you'll be too slow here. You'll get scripts with clear direction, but you're expected to make visual and generative decisions on your own and move fast.



If you want a 9-to-5 with clearly defined boundaries, we respect that — but this isn't the gig.



What you get.



$1,500/month base. Performance bonus when ads you edit become winners — the better they perform, the more you make. The base is the floor, not the ceiling. Editors who cut winning ads earn significantly more through performance bonuses, and there is no cap.



Direct access to the founder. No account managers relaying notes through a chain. You'll work alongside the person who built the brand and makes the scaling decisions. When an ad you cut starts spending $1,000/day, the founder knows exactly who edited it.



You also get volume. We're spending $100K+/month on Meta, which means your edits go live fast and you get performance data back fast. You'll learn more about what actually works in paid AI-produced advertising in three months here than in a year anywhere else — because every edit you make gets tested against real buyers with real money.

SaaS, eCommerce, and industrial marketing.

Qualifications

Preferred

title: Reddit Community Builder (Peptide / Health Optimization Niche)
description:
FOUR HARD REQUIREMENTS. If you do not meet all four, do not apply. I read every

application and I will not reply to the ones that ignore this.



1. YOU ALREADY KNOW PEPTIDES. Not "willing to learn". Already in this world.

   If you have never heard of BPC-157, retatrutide or a COA, this is not for

   you.



2. YOUR OWN AGED REDDIT ACCOUNTS. Real accounts with real karma and a real

   comment history, which you will show me. A fresh account posting into these

   subreddits gets filtered or shadowbanned and you will never even be told it

   happened. If you are planning to make new accounts for this, do not apply.



3. A TRACK RECORD YOU CAN SHOW ME AND EXPLAIN. Communities you have grown or

   moderated. Live links. On the call I will ask you to walk me through what you

   did and why it worked. Work you cannot explain does not count.



4. FLUENT ENGLISH, WRITTEN AND SPOKEN. You are writing as a member of a

   sceptical, technical community and you will be on a video call with me.



ABOUT US



We run a marketplace for research peptides. Customers compare suppliers on real

prices, read published lab reports and order directly. Our best traffic has

always come from Reddit, by a wide margin on engagement, and we have never had

anyone working on it properly.



THE ROLE



Build and run an organic community in this niche that we own, and turn it into

a real source of visitors.



- Research the landscape. Which subreddits the audience already lives in, what

  they argue about, what gets removed and why

- Build the community. Set it up, seed it, set the culture, grow it to the

  point where it has its own momentum

- Post and comment daily as a genuine member. Answer questions properly, be

  useful before being promotional

- Moderate. Rules, automod, spam, keeping the tone right

- Route traffic to us the way it actually works on Reddit, which is slowly and

  through trust, not through dropped links

- Weekly report on growth, engagement and what is working



Be clear about this: we are not paying you to spam links. That gets accounts

banned and communities killed. We are paying you to build something people

actually want to be in.



WHAT WILL GET YOU REJECTED



- Fresh accounts, bought accounts, or vote manipulation

- Link dropping into other people's subreddits

- Anything that reads like it came out of ChatGPT

- Not knowing what automod is



HOURS AND PAY



Part time to start, 20 hours per week, USD 500 to 650 per month depending on

what you bring. Flexible hours.



Goes full time at USD 800 to 1100 per month within 60 days if the community is

growing.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your message with the word RETATRUTIDE so I know you read this far.



Answer these three in your own words. Short is fine, honest is better than

polished:



1. Which subreddits does this audience actually live in? Name them, and tell me

   which ones would remove a post like ours and why.



2. You are starting a new community in this niche from zero. What are your

   first two weeks? Be specific.



3. Tell me about a community you grew or moderated. What did you do when it

   stalled?



Include:

- Links to your Reddit accounts, with karma and account age visible

- Links to communities you have built or moderated

- An unlisted video, 2 minutes maximum, just you talking, answering this:

  "Why do most brands fail on Reddit?" No slides, no reading from a script.



No video, no review. The video is how I check your spoken English, so please do

not skip it.

title: Marketing & Growth Manager
description:
Own the marketing. Generate qualified customers. Share in the results.

Company: Anderson Heating, Air & Insulation

Location: Remote, Philippines

Compensation: $15–$20 USD per hour, based on demonstrated experience, plus substantial performance bonus opportunities

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time, including a scheduled one-hour meal break. Approximately 40 working hours per week.

Opportunity: Full-time, long-term role working directly with company leadership

About the opportunity

Anderson Heating, Air & Insulation is an established home-services company based in Calhoun, Georgia. We are looking for an experienced, hands-on marketing professional to take ownership of our marketing, strengthen our online presence, and generate more qualified customers.

Our priority is more HVAC repair calls, replacement opportunities, and commercial repair and maintenance customers in Calhoun and our surrounding service area.

We are looking for someone who can turn marketing into measurable business, not just traffic, impressions, or reports.

You will have direct access to leadership, support from our existing team, and room to recommend and implement improvements. We want someone who can investigate, prioritize, execute, and follow through without needing a daily task list.

What you will own

Google Ads and qualified lead generation

Manage and improve our Google Ads campaigns, targeting, messaging, landing pages, and conversion tracking. Focus on attracting customers who need our services within our approved service area. Identify other promising marketing channels, recommend focused tests, and evaluate whether the results justify the spending.

Our website and customer conversion

Take ownership of the website’s marketing performance, including service pages, landing pages, content, and the paths visitors use to contact us. Make improvements directly where you have the skills and coordinate technical help when necessary. You do not need to personally code everything, but you must make sure approved improvements get completed and work correctly.

Google Business Profile, local SEO, and AI-search visibility

Improve how Anderson appears in local search and AI-assisted search experiences. We want someone with strong SEO fundamentals who stays current with how search is changing and can apply useful new approaches without relying on hype or unsupported ranking promises.

Accurate business information across the web

Audit and improve our Google Business Profile, Yelp, Better Business Bureau profile, business directories, and other relevant mentions of Anderson. Identify outdated branding, incorrect business information, duplicate listings, missing services, and confusing descriptions. Correct what we control, pursue corrections on third-party platforms, and track unresolved issues.

Lead tracking and the office handoff

Establish reliable tracking from the original marketing source through qualified inquiry, booked appointment, completed work, and collected revenue.

Our office handles customer calls, appointment booking, and sales follow-up. You will work with them to establish a dependable handoff, monitor outcomes, and help resolve problems when opportunities are missed. Your responsibility does not end when a lead is delivered.

Reporting, prioritization, and follow-through

Explain what is working, what is not, and what should happen next. Work with leadership and bookkeeping to understand acquisition costs and the profitability of the work being generated. Document important processes and take responsibility for maintaining the improvements you implement.

Who we are looking for

You should have demonstrated experience generating customers for local service businesses. HVAC experience is valuable, but relevant results in plumbing, electrical, roofing, or similar services are also welcome.

We are looking for:

Hands-on marketing ability: Relevant experience with Google Ads, local SEO, Google Business Profile, website improvements, and lead tracking.

Practical AI skills: The ability to use AI effectively for research, audits, analysis, content, and workflow improvements while checking its output and taking responsibility for decisions.

Independent ownership: The ability to identify opportunities, set priorities, implement approved changes, and follow through without constant direction.

Strong communication and business judgment: The ability to work with employees, explain results clearly, manage approved resources, and recognize when specialist support is needed.

You do not need to be an expert in every marketing channel or know every system we use on day one. Experience with Housecall Pro, customer reactivation, call tracking, and marketing automation is helpful.

Building complicated AI systems is not the primary purpose of this role. Using the right tools and judgment to generate profitable growth is.

A degree is not required. Your demonstrated work and results matter more than your previous title or certificates.

You will be part of our team

This is a dedicated position within Anderson, not an outside advisory assignment.

You will use our company phone and communication systems and work with leadership, office staff, and relevant field employees. You will also have access to our existing virtual assistant for agreed supporting work, such as research, listing updates, and data cleanup. You remain responsible for the strategy, instructions, quality, and results.

We will provide appropriate access to company information and systems, including Housecall Pro and QuickBooks where relevant to your responsibilities.

We are willing to fund useful software, approved marketing tests, and specialist support when there is a sound business case. We will agree on priorities, budgets, and approval boundaries, then expect you to manage execution.

All work must use company-owned accounts where appropriate, protect customer information, and leave Anderson with accessible records and documentation.

How success will be measured

We will evaluate qualified inquiries, booked appointments, resulting business, acquisition costs, and contribution to profitable growth.

Traffic, rankings, clicks, and impressions are useful indicators, but they are not the final objective.

During your first 90 days, we will expect you to learn the business, establish a baseline, address priority online-presence problems, implement tracking, and launch or improve a focused set of marketing initiatives. We will agree on realistic targets based on our starting position, budget, and service capacity.

Compensation and bonuses

The base rate is $15–$20 USD per hour, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated ability. We are prepared to pay at the upper end for the right person.

In addition, there will be substantial performance bonus opportunities tied to measurable new or recovered profitable business you help create.

The bonus structure will be agreed in writing before you start, including how results are measured, how contributions are credited, and when bonuses are paid.

We want this to become a rewarding, well-paid, long-term position. Strong performance should create meaningful opportunities to earn more.

Schedule and working expectations

You must be consistently available Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time, with the scheduled meal break. Availability must follow U.S. Eastern Time throughout the year, including its seasonal clock changes. This is an overnight schedule in the Philippines.

You will participate in relevant meetings, remain reachable through our company communication systems, and record working hours using company-approved timekeeping software.

Reliable internet, a suitable computer, and a professional environment for calls and meetings are required.

How to apply

Please submit your résumé or professional profile, desired hourly rate, earliest availability, and confirmation that you can consistently work the stated schedule.

Include one strong example of results you personally helped produce for a local service business. Briefly explain the business, your specific responsibilities, the marketing channels and approximate budget, and what improved. Distinguish verified bookings or revenue from estimates and general lead counts.

You may share redacted examples. Do not disclose another company’s confidential information.

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to walk through their work and complete a small, paid practical assessment. We are not asking for a full unpaid marketing audit.

We are looking for someone who wants to become a trusted member of our team, take ownership of marketing, and help Anderson grow through measurable results.

description:
Key Responsibilities: 

- Develop Persuasive Copy: Write clear, compelling, and persuasive sales copy for a variety of outbound and inbound channels, including
 campaigns, cold outreach, website, and social media. 

- Understand Target Audience: Conduct research to understand the pain points, needs, and desires of our target audience, thereby producing relevant customer personas and journeys. 

- Implement Effective SEO Practices: Conduct keyword optimisation and create customer-centric website copy to attract and engage potential customers. 

- Conduct Competitor Analysis: Study the copywriting techniques of our competitors in their various channels for inspiration and best practices, and make informed decisions on improving our own channels. 

- Create Engaging Content: Develop attention-grabbing subject lines, headlines, and calls to action that encourage engagement and conversion. 

- Master the Company’s Product/Service: Build a deep understanding of the features of our product/service in order to integrate it into effective copywriting. 

- Collaborate with Lead Gen and HubSpot Teams: Work closely with the Lead Gen and HubSpot teams to align copy with overall strategies and goals. 

- Optimise for Performance: Continuously test and optimise copy to improve open rates, click-through rates, and conversion rates. 

- Report on Copy Performance: Synthesise copy performance data and insights into actionable recommendations for campaign optimisation and future copy strategy. 

- Stay Up-to-Date: Keep up with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in copywriting and outbound and inbound sales strategies. 



Primary Brand Focus:

You will primarily write copy for the Canadian Indigenous Investment Forum (CIIF), a year-round investment forum that connects Indigenous-led businesses and communities with institutional investors from the UK, Europe, and North America. Visit 
 to learn more. You will also support copywriting initiatives across other client brands as needed.



Qualifications: 

- Marketing and Sales Experience: Proven understanding of marketing and sales principles and a track record of crafting copy that drives action. 

- Research Skills: Ability to conduct thorough research and synthesise information to create compelling narratives. 

- Proven Copywriting Experience: At least 5 years of relevant experience in copywriting or related fields. 

- Strong Writing Skills: Exceptional writing, editing, and proofreading skills, with a keen eye for detail. 

- Creativity: Innovative thinker with the ability to generate unique ideas and concepts. 

- Collaboration: Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. 

- Time Management: Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines. 

- Analytical Skills: Proficient in using analytics tools to extract and measure copy performance metrics (open rates, clickthrough rates, conversion rates, and engagement data) and search visibility. 

- Data-driven Thinking Skills: Ability to interpret, evaluate, and synthesise data findings and insights to inform strategic decisions and identify patterns that drive copy and campaign improvement. 

- Product/Service Knowledge: Ability to rapidly build a deep understanding of complex product or service features and translate technical specifications into compelling, customer-centric narratives. 

- Strategic Vision: Ability to position each copy within the broader context of the full campaign strategy, the marketing funnel, and brand identity, recognising that copy does not exist in isolation.



To be considered, kindly fill out the form using this link: 
/SalesCopyWriter

title: Senior AI Video & Creative Designer
description:
SENIOR AI VIDEO DESIGNER / AI CREATIVE



AI VIDEO IS THE PRIORITY.



SUPR is looking for an exceptionally strong AI Video Designer / AI Creative capable of producing work that feels like a high-end global commercial — not obviously AI-generated content.



We are not looking for someone who has simply learned a few AI tools or knows how to animate images.



We want someone who understands cinematography, storytelling, art direction, advertising and AI production — and knows how to bring all of them together.



WHAT YOU’LL CREATE



You’ll work across SUPR’s performance, sports and lifestyle ecosystem to produce:



- Cinematic AI brand films

- Product commercials

- Social-first campaign videos

- Product launch films

- Performance & sports visuals

- AI-generated environments and scenes

- Short-form Reels / TikTok / paid ads

- Product animations and visual effects

- AI + real-footage hybrid content

- Campaign key visuals

- Product renders and mockups

- Selected graphic design and digital assets



WHAT YOU NEED TO BE VERY GOOD AT



AI VIDEO GENERATION



Advanced experience with platforms and workflows such as:



Google Veo / Kling / Runway / Sora / Midjourney / FLUX / ComfyUI / Stable Diffusion or equivalent



You should understand more than prompting.



We expect strong knowledge of:



- Text-to-video

- Image-to-video

- Reference-based generation

- Character consistency

- Product consistency

- Scene consistency

- Camera control and movement

- Lighting

- Composition

- Realistic physics and movement

- Lip sync where required

- Upscaling and enhancement

- Inpainting / compositing

- AI asset creation

- Multi-shot sequencing

- Prompt engineering

- Workflow optimization



CINEMATIC & CREATIVE SKILLS



You should understand how a commercial is actually constructed.



That means:



Concept → Storyboard → Shot List → Generation → Selection → Editing → Sound → Colour → Final Delivery



You should have a strong understanding of:



- Cinematography

- Art direction

- Camera angles and lenses

- Lighting

- Pacing

- Transitions

- Sound design

- Music selection

- Colour grading

- Typography

- Visual storytelling



Beautiful individual AI shots are not enough.



You need to know how to turn those shots into a complete campaign.



VIDEO EDITING & POST-PRODUCTION



Strong experience with tools such as:



After Effects / Premiere Pro / DaVinci Resolve / CapCut or equivalent



You should be comfortable taking AI-generated assets all the way to a finished, polished commercial.



GRAPHIC DESIGN



Graphic design is secondary to AI video, but you should still have a strong visual foundation.



Experience with:



Photoshop / Illustrator / Figma / AI image-generation workflows



is highly preferred.



WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR



You should be someone who:



- Has exceptional visual taste

- Thinks creatively without needing to be spoon-fed

- Can turn a rough idea into a complete concept

- Understands premium global branding

- Understands sports, fitness, fashion and lifestyle culture

- Keeps up with rapidly changing AI technology

- Experiments constantly with new AI workflows

- Can work quickly without producing sloppy work

- Takes feedback well and iterates fast

- Notices details other people miss

- Can work independently and meet deadlines



Most importantly:



You need to be obsessed with making great work.



We want someone who can take a simple brief and come back with something better than what we imagined.



PORTFOLIO IS COMPULSORY



Do not apply without AI video work.



Your portfolio should preferably include:



- Cinematic AI videos

- AI product commercials

- Photorealistic AI generation

- Multi-scene AI storytelling

- Consistent characters/products across shots

- Sports/fashion/lifestyle campaigns

- AI + live-footage compositions

- Finished commercial edits



Please send us your best 3–5 pieces, not your entire portfolio.



We care much more about quality than quantity.



SHORTLISTED APPLICANTS



Shortlisted candidates may be given a short paid creative test based on a SUPR product.



This allows us to evaluate:



Creative thinking • AI generation quality • Product accuracy • Cinematography • Editing • Storytelling • Attention to detail



NOT THE RIGHT ROLE IF



Your AI experience is mainly:



- Basic prompting

- Template-based videos

- Simple image animation

- AI talking avatars

- Generic AI transitions

- Copying existing AI trends without developing your own concepts



We are looking for someone who understands how to direct AI, not simply operate an AI tool.



THE STANDARD



When someone watches our content, we don't want their first thought to be:



“That's an AI video.”



We want them to think:



“How the hell did they make that?”



If that's the level of work you create, we want to see it.
